entries.label_vi: Cá nhân: thói quen hằng ngày cộng lại tạo tác động môi trường lớn
entries.claim: Everyday personal choices add up to a large environmental effect.
entries.because: Millions of households decide how they travel, what they buy and how much they waste, and consumers who choose cleaner products push companies to change.
entries.result: Without changed habits, even strong laws are hard to enforce.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề cá nhân vs chính phủ (ô nhiễm, nước, carbon, rác, năng lượng).

entries.label_vi: Cá nhân không giải quyết được vấn đề mang tính hệ thống
entries.claim: Individuals alone cannot solve problems that are largely structural.
entries.because: A person cannot choose a clean power grid, a safe water supply or a recycling system that does not exist, and the biggest polluters are often industries rather than households.
entries.result: Relying on personal virtue leaves the largest sources of damage untouched.
entries.reuse_vi: Lập luận ủng hộ vai trò chính phủ.

entries.label_vi: Chính phủ đặt luật chung cho mọi người (thuế, mức trần, phạt)
entries.claim: Governments can set rules that apply to everyone.
entries.because: Taxes, limits and fines create a level playing field, so responsible firms are not undercut by careless ones.
entries.result: Rules change behaviour on a scale that personal appeals cannot reach.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề vai trò chính phủ / luật môi trường.

entries.label_vi: Chỉ chính phủ xây được hạ tầng khiến lựa chọn xanh trở nên dễ
entries.claim: Only governments can build the infrastructure that makes green choices practical.
entries.because: Public transport, recycling plants, water networks and renewable power need large investment and long-term planning.
entries.result: When the green option is also the easy one, ordinary people choose it.
entries.reuse_vi: Dùng cho đề giao thông công cộng, tái chế, năng lượng.

entries.label_vi: Kết hợp: chính phủ dẫn dắt, người dân thực hiện hằng ngày
entries.claim: The most effective approach combines official leadership with personal action.
entries.because: The state sets the framework and incentives, while citizens supply the daily decisions that make policies work.
entries.result: Neither side can succeed alone.
entries.reuse_vi: Câu kết cho mọi đề cá nhân vs xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Người dân thường là người đầu tiên thấy vi phạm môi trường
entries.claim: Ordinary people are often the first to notice environmental damage.
entries.because: Residents see the smoke, the discoloured river or the night-time dumping, and no inspector can be everywhere at once.
entries.result: Reports from the public extend the reach of the authorities at low cost.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề báo cáo vi phạm / giám sát cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Nhà sản xuất chịu trách nhiệm thu hồi sản phẩm cũ
entries.claim: Manufacturers should be required to take back what they sell.
entries.because: When companies pay for collection and recycling, they have a reason to design products that last and can be repaired.
entries.result: The burden moves from households to the businesses that profit from the product.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề rác điện tử, bao bì, tái chế.

entries.text: A commuter who swaps a daily car journey for a bicycle, for example, avoids a noticeable amount of exhaust gas each year.
A city that loses a third of its water through old pipes, for instance, wastes more than its residents could ever save.
A resident of a town with no reliable buses or trains, for instance, has little choice but to drive.
A fisherman who notices a poisoned stream and phones a hotline, for example, may stop pollution before it spreads.

entries.label_vi: Biện pháp môi trường nghiêm ngặt làm tăng chi phí doanh nghiệp, chậm tăng trưởng ngắn hạn
entries.claim: Strict environmental measures can raise costs for businesses and slow short-term growth.
entries.because: Factories must install cleaner equipment, and firms may respond by raising prices or cutting jobs, which matters most in poorer countries where growth is needed to lift people out of poverty.
entries.result: Hardship and political opposition follow if rules are too sudden.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía ưu tiên kinh tế trong đề kinh tế vs môi trường.

entries.label_vi: Bỏ qua môi trường về lâu dài còn đắt hơn (lũ, hạn, ô nhiễm, dọn dẹp)
entries.claim: Ignoring the environment is expensive in the long run.
entries.because: Floods, droughts and polluted air damage crops, homes and health, and the cost of cleaning up afterwards is usually far higher than the cost of preventing the damage.
entries.result: Growth built on damage cannot last.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía ưu tiên môi trường / chính sách khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Chính sách môi trường cũng tạo tăng trưởng và việc làm
entries.claim: Environmental policy can itself create growth and employment.
entries.because: Renewable energy, insulation and recycling employ workers and encourage new technology.
entries.result: Clean industries can be sold abroad as well as used at home.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng tái tạo tạo việc làm, công nghệ xanh.

entries.label_vi: Bên gây ô nhiễm phải trả chi phí khắc phục
entries.claim: Corporations that profit from an activity should bear the cost of its damage.
entries.because: When the clean-up falls on taxpayers the company profits while the public pays, whereas fines and taxes make firms include environmental costs in their prices.
entries.result: Firms then have a reason to adopt cleaner methods.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề trách nhiệm doanh nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Bằng chứng khoa học gắn nóng lên với hoạt động con người
entries.claim: Scientific evidence links the recent rise in temperatures to human activity.
entries.because: Burning coal, oil and gas and clearing forests release gases that trap heat, and temperatures have risen alongside emissions since the industrial era began.
entries.result: Natural cycles that operate over thousands of years cannot explain such rapid warming.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nguyên nhân biến đổi khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Yếu tố tự nhiên: núi lửa, chu kỳ mặt trời, dòng hải lưu
entries.claim: The climate has always changed through natural causes.
entries.because: Volcanic eruptions, variations in the sun's energy and shifts in ocean currents produced warm periods and ice ages long before humans existed.
entries.result: Some people therefore argue that today's warming may be part of a natural cycle.
entries.reuse_vi: Phía nguyên nhân tự nhiên.

entries.label_vi: Thích ứng: bảo vệ người dân khỏi tác hại đang xảy ra (đê, cảnh báo sớm, cây chịu hạn)
entries.claim: Adaptation protects people from harm that is already happening.
entries.because: Sea walls, flood defences, drought-resistant crops and early warning systems save lives and homes within a few years, whereas cuts in emissions take decades to change the climate.
entries.result: Countries that produce little pollution but suffer its effects are helped most.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thích ứng vs giảm thiểu khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Giảm thiểu: cắt phát thải tại nguồn, thích ứng chỉ chữa triệu chứng
entries.claim: Adaptation alone only treats the symptoms.
entries.because: Cutting emissions at their source through renewable energy, efficient buildings and cleaner transport reduces the scale of the problem, whereas defences become more expensive as temperatures rise.
entries.result: Prevention is far cheaper than dealing with the consequences later.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thích ứng vs giảm thiểu khí hậu.

entries.label_vi: Ngân sách có hạn, nhiều ưu tiên cấp bách khác (y tế, giáo dục, nhà ở)
entries.claim: Governments have limited funds and many equally urgent responsibilities.
entries.because: Hospitals, schools, housing and welfare all need money now, and people cannot wait for the long-term benefits of climate policy.
entries.result: In poorer countries spending heavily on emissions cuts may seem a luxury.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu chính phủ: môi trường vs ưu tiên khác.

entries.text: A developing country that bans cheap coal before it has an alternative, for example, may leave millions of households without affordable electricity.
A government that allows a river to become heavily polluted, for example, must later pay for water treatment and for the illnesses that follow.
A city that invests in clean transport, for instance, reduces hospital costs from air pollution while creating jobs in construction and maintenance.
A chemical company that knows it will pay for any spill, for example, will invest more in safety.
A coastal town that builds a flood barrier, for example, protects its residents from the next storm, whatever the world does about emissions.

entries.label_vi: Năng lượng tái tạo sạch hơn than, dầu, khí; ít khí nhà kính, không khói hại phổi
entries.claim: Renewable energy is cleaner than coal, oil and gas.
entries.because: Solar panels and wind turbines produce electricity without burning fuel, so they release almost no greenhouse gases and none of the smoke that harms people's lungs in crowded cities.
entries.result: The air is cleaner and hospitals treat fewer patients with breathing problems.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng tái tạo, ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Giảm phụ thuộc nhiên liệu nhập khẩu, nguồn cung ổn định hơn
entries.claim: Investing in renewables makes a country less dependent on imported fuel.
entries.because: Nations that buy oil and gas from abroad are exposed to sudden price rises and political disputes, whereas home-grown wind and solar power gives them a more stable and secure supply.
entries.result: The economy is shielded from external shocks.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của năng lượng tái tạo / an ninh năng lượng.

entries.label_vi: Chi phí điện mặt trời / gió giảm nhờ công nghệ, sản xuất quy mô lớn, cạnh tranh
entries.claim: The cost of solar and wind equipment has fallen as the technology has improved.
entries.because: As manufacturers build larger factories and produce more equipment, each panel or turbine costs less to make, and competition pushes prices down.
entries.result: Clean power can now compete with coal and gas in many places without large subsidies.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi phí năng lượng tái tạo giảm.

entries.label_vi: Nắng gió không ổn định → cần pin lưu trữ, lưới điện linh hoạt, nguồn dự phòng
entries.claim: The sun does not always shine and the wind does not always blow.
entries.because: Supply from renewables varies from hour to hour, so grids need batteries, flexible demand and backup power to stay reliable.
entries.result: These costs are real but falling as storage improves.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm / giới hạn của năng lượng tái tạo.

entries.label_vi: Công nghiệp nặng, hàng không, vận tải biển khó chạy bằng điện; nước đang phát triển còn dựa vào than
entries.claim: Heavy industry, aviation and shipping are hard to run on electricity.
entries.because: Steel, cement and long-distance transport need very high temperatures or dense, light fuels, and many developing countries still rely on cheap coal and oil to grow.
entries.result: Replacement of fossil fuels will be uneven and gradual rather than sudden.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của việc thay thế nhiên liệu hoá thạch.

entries.label_vi: Điện tái tạo cần nhiều lao động: sản xuất, xây dựng, lắp đặt, bảo trì
entries.claim: Building and running renewable energy requires a wide range of workers.
entries.because: Factories make panels and turbine blades, construction crews build wind farms and solar parks, electricians install equipment and technicians repair machines for decades afterwards.
entries.result: Many of these jobs are located in local communities, which spreads the benefit widely.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đầu tư năng lượng tái tạo tạo việc làm.

entries.text: A city that replaces a coal power station with wind and solar farms, for example, can breathe cleaner air within a few years.
A household that fits solar panels today, for example, pays much less than a neighbour did a decade ago.
A factory that makes steel, for instance, cannot switch to wind power in a few years.
A town that hosts a new wind farm, for example, may gain hundreds of jobs during construction and a smaller number of permanent posts for maintenance.

entries.label_vi: Điện hạt nhân: sản lượng lớn, ổn định ngày đêm, gần như không phát thải carbon
entries.claim: Nuclear plants produce large amounts of low-carbon electricity.
entries.because: A single plant can run day and night whatever the weather, and a small amount of fuel produces a great deal of energy, so it provides steady power while releasing almost no greenhouse gases.
entries.result: Countries reduce their dependence on imported coal and gas.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề năng lượng hạt nhân (ưu điểm).

entries.label_vi: Tai nạn hạt nhân hiếm nhưng hậu quả nghiêm trọng, lâu dài (Chernobyl, Fukushima)
entries.claim: The consequences of a nuclear accident can be severe and long-lasting.
entries.because: The disasters at Chernobyl and Fukushima forced thousands of people to leave their homes, and some areas remained unusable for years.
entries.result: Many citizens feel uneasy about living near a plant.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hạt nhân (rủi ro an toàn).

entries.label_vi: Chất thải phóng xạ phải lưu trữ hàng nghìn năm; nhà máy đắt, xây lâu, vượt ngân sách
entries.claim: Radioactive waste must be stored safely for thousands of years.
entries.because: This places a burden on future generations, and plants are very expensive and often take over a decade to build, so they may be late and over budget.
entries.result: Poorer countries may struggle to provide the strict regulation and trained staff needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hạt nhân (chất thải, chi phí).

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ xanh vừa cải thiện môi trường vừa tiết kiệm tiền (hiệu quả năng lượng)
entries.claim: Green technology improves the environment while saving money.
entries.because: Efficient buildings, appliances and factories use less energy, so they reduce both pollution and bills, and the country spends less on imported fuel and on treating illnesses caused by dirty air.
entries.result: Early investment pays off in the long term.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của công nghệ xanh / giao thông xanh.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông tái tạo: không khói thải, không khí sạch hơn, ít ồn, tốt cho sức khoẻ
entries.claim: Renewable transport improves air quality and public health.
entries.because: Electric buses and cars produce no exhaust fumes on the road, and when their power comes from wind or solar they release far fewer greenhouse gases over their lifetime.
entries.result: Residents of crowded cities breathe cleaner air and noise levels fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông xanh / ô nhiễm đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Nhiên liệu sinh học giảm phát thải giao thông, dùng được trong động cơ hiện có
entries.claim: Biofuels can reduce the carbon emissions of transport.
entries.because: Plants absorb carbon dioxide as they grow, so in theory the fuel releases about the same amount that it removed from the air, and it can be used in existing engines with little change.
entries.result: Countries can cut emissions from millions of cars quickly and depend less on imported oil.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhiên liệu sinh học (ưu điểm).

entries.label_vi: Cây nhiên liệu cạnh tranh đất với lương thực, đẩy giá, phá rừng
entries.claim: Biofuels raise serious concerns about land and food.
entries.because: Fuel crops need farmland, so they may compete with food production and push up prices, and if forests are cleared to plant them the carbon released can cancel out the benefits.
entries.result: Poorer families are hurt most; fuel made from waste avoids many problems but supplies are limited.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhiên liệu sinh học (nhược điểm), nông nghiệp.

entries.text: A country with several reactors, for example, can keep its lights on during a calm, cloudy week without burning fossil fuels.
A city that replaces diesel buses with electric ones, for example, enjoys quieter streets and cleaner air, and its transport company spends less on fuel in the long run.
A country that becomes known for efficient batteries, for instance, can sell them to many others.

entries.label_vi: Nhựa tồn tại hàng thế kỷ, vỡ thành vi nhựa, hại động vật biển, vào chuỗi thức ăn
entries.claim: Plastic persists in the environment for centuries.
entries.because: Single-use items rarely decompose; instead they break into tiny pieces called microplastics, which are found in rivers, soil and even the food that people eat.
entries.result: Marine animals swallow plastic or become trapped in it, and cleaning up afterwards is extremely difficult and costly.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cấm nhựa dùng một lần, ô nhiễm đại dương.

entries.label_vi: Lệnh cấm hiệu quả khi có phương án thay thế (túi vải, ống hút kim loại, chai dùng lại); phí túi nhựa làm giảm mạnh việc dùng
entries.claim: Bans work when alternatives exist.
entries.because: Paper bags, cloth shopping bags, metal straws and reusable bottles perform the same function and can be used many times, and a small charge for plastic bags sharply reduced their use in several countries.
entries.result: People adapt quickly once the habit is changed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cấm nhựa, giảm bao bì.

entries.label_vi: Lệnh cấm không đủ: vật thay thế tốn năng lượng, khó thực thi, nguồn nhựa khác vẫn gây ô nhiễm
entries.claim: Bans are not enough on their own.
entries.because: Some substitutes such as paper or thick cotton bags need more energy to produce, enforcement can be weak among small sellers, and plastic from other sources continues to pollute.
entries.result: Bans should be combined with deposit schemes, better recycling and public education.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của lệnh cấm / nhượng bộ.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: đặt cọc vỏ chai, phí túi nhựa, buộc nhà sản xuất trả phí thu gom
entries.claim: Deposit schemes and charges change habits.
entries.because: When customers receive a small refund for returning bottles, return rates rise, and a charge on disposable items encourages people to bring their own.
entries.result: Bottles stay out of the environment and the material is reused instead of wasted.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm rác nhựa / rác thải.

entries.label_vi: Nhiều bao bì thừa: bọc nhiều lớp, hộp quá lớn, phục vụ tiếp thị hơn là bảo vệ
entries.claim: Much packaging exists for marketing rather than protection.
entries.because: Attractive boxes, extra layers and oversized containers make products look more valuable, but they are thrown away as soon as the item is opened.
entries.result: Over a year such small choices add up to huge quantities of rubbish.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bao bì thừa, lãng phí.

entries.label_vi: Bao bì cần thiết bảo vệ thực phẩm, vệ sinh, kéo dài hạn dùng → giảm lãng phí thức ăn
entries.claim: Some packaging is necessary.
entries.because: It protects food from damage, keeps it hygienic and can extend its shelf life, which reduces food waste, and fragile goods need protection in transport.
entries.result: The answer is to design packaging better rather than to abolish it.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhượng bộ trong đề bao bì.

entries.label_vi: Quy chuẩn thiết kế: cỡ nhỏ nhất phù hợp, vật liệu tái chế, nhà sản xuất trả phí rác
entries.claim: Producers should be required to pay for the waste they create.
entries.because: This encourages them to design simpler, recyclable packaging, using the smallest suitable size and materials that can be reused or recycled.
entries.result: Waste falls at its source instead of being managed afterwards.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giới hạn bao bì / trách nhiệm nhà sản xuất.

entries.text: A beach covered with bottles and bags, for example, harms wildlife and also discourages tourists, which damages the local economy.
When shops in several countries introduced a small charge for plastic bags, for instance, their use fell sharply.
entries.caution_vi: Đã ghi nhận ở nhiều nước; nêu chung chung.

entries.text: A cucumber wrapped in plastic, for example, already has its own natural skin, so the extra layer adds waste without adding protection.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: làm tái chế dễ dàng (thùng mã màu, thu gom định kỳ, điểm tái chế, nhãn rõ ràng)
entries.claim: Governments should make recycling convenient.
entries.because: Households are more likely to sort their rubbish if collection is regular, bins are clearly marked and the rules are simple.
entries.result: Only governments can build the sorting plants and collection networks that make recycling practical.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khuyến khích tái chế.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: tạo động lực (đặt cọc, giảm phí cho hộ ít rác, bắt buộc dùng vật liệu tái chế, giáo dục)
entries.claim: Authorities should give people good reasons to take part in recycling.
entries.because: Deposit schemes raise return rates sharply, lower charges reward households that produce less general waste, and requiring manufacturers to use recycled material creates a market for what households collect.
entries.result: Participation rises and the system pays for itself.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tái chế / rác thải.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp rác vứt bừa: nhiều thùng rác dễ thấy, dọn thường xuyên, thùng phân loại có biểu tượng
entries.claim: Governments should make proper disposal easy.
entries.because: People are more likely to use a bin if one is close by, so councils should place well-marked bins in busy streets and empty them often so they do not overflow.
entries.result: Clean surroundings also set an example, because people tend to drop rubbish where litter already exists.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề rác nơi công cộng.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp rác vứt bừa: phạt rõ ràng, tuần tra / camera, lao động công ích, giáo dục
entries.claim: Authorities should discourage careless behaviour.
entries.because: Visible fines supported by patrols or cameras in problem areas make people think twice, and public campaigns explain the harm that litter causes to animals and neighbourhoods.
entries.result: Combined with more bins and a deposit scheme, litter may fall sharply within a year.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề rác nơi công cộng.

entries.label_vi: Tái chế bắt buộc: tăng tỷ lệ tham gia, thành thói quen; cần dịch vụ thuận tiện và thực thi hợp lý
entries.claim: Mandatory recycling creates much higher participation.
entries.because: When recycling is optional many people ignore it because it takes effort and the benefit seems small, whereas a clear legal requirement turns it into a normal habit, as seat belts became normal once compulsory.
entries.result: Compulsion works only if people are given the means to comply: convenient collection, clear instructions and warnings before penalties.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tái chế bắt buộc.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân lãng phí thực phẩm: mua quá nhiều, hiểu sai nhãn hạn dùng, loại bỏ nông sản xấu mã, khẩu phần lớn
entries.claim: Overbuying and strict rules about appearance and dates are major causes of food waste.
entries.because: Shoppers buy more than they need, attracted by bulk offers; many misunderstand date labels; and supermarkets reject fruit and vegetables of the wrong size or shape, while restaurants serve portions that are too large.
entries.result: Edible food is wasted before anyone has a chance to eat it.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lãng phí thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: nhãn rõ ràng, bán nông sản xấu mã giá rẻ, chuyển thực phẩm dư cho ngân hàng thực phẩm, giáo dục, thu gom rác thực phẩm
entries.claim: Governments should require clearer labels and encourage retailers to pass on surplus food.
entries.because: Selling imperfect produce at lower prices and giving unsold but edible food to charities means that surplus feeds people instead of landfill.
entries.result: Families also cut their grocery bills.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lãng phí thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Vòng đời ngắn tăng khai thác, sản xuất, rác điện tử; văn hoá vứt đi
entries.claim: Making a new product uses large amounts of energy, water and raw materials.
entries.because: Most of a phone's environmental impact comes from mining and manufacturing rather than daily use, so replacing it after two years instead of five increases that impact.
entries.result: Cheap, quickly outdated goods encourage a throwaway culture and fill landfill sites.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề vòng đời sản phẩm, bảo hành, thời trang nhanh.

entries.label_vi: Bảo hành dài buộc nhà sản xuất làm đồ bền, dễ sửa; sửa chữa thành lựa chọn bình thường
entries.claim: Longer warranties give manufacturers a reason to build durable goods.
entries.because: If a company must repair or replace its products for five years instead of one, it will use stronger parts and better testing, because failures become costly.
entries.result: Fewer items are made and discarded, and repair becomes the normal choice.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo hành, vòng đời, sửa chữa.

entries.text: A resident with no collection point nearby, for example, has little chance of recycling even when they want to.
A park with a bin every fifty metres, for example, will usually be cleaner than one with only a few.
A bag of misshapen carrots that never reaches the shelf, for example, is wasted before anyone has a chance to eat it.
A washing machine with a ten-year guarantee, for example, is likely to be built to last, and its owner does not need to buy a replacement after two years.

entries.label_vi: Cây biến đổi gen: năng suất cao hơn, chịu hạn và sâu bệnh, giảm thuốc trừ sâu, thêm vi chất
entries.claim: Genetically modified crops can produce higher and more reliable yields.
entries.because: Plants can be changed to resist pests, tolerate drought or contain extra vitamins, so farmers lose less of their harvest and need fewer chemicals.
entries.result: More food is grown on the same land, which helps a growing population.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cây trồng biến đổi gen, đổi mới nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Cây biến đổi gen: chưa rõ tác động dài hạn, lệ thuộc công ty hạt giống, gen lan sang cây dại
entries.claim: The long-term effects of genetically modified crops are not fully known.
entries.because: Modified genes could spread to wild plants, and farmers who buy patented seed each year become dependent on a few large companies.
entries.result: Many consumers distrust modified food, so careful testing and clear labels are needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cây biến đổi gen (nhược điểm).

entries.label_vi: Đổi mới nông nghiệp (tưới nhỏ giọt, nông nghiệp chính xác, giống tốt): tăng sản lượng, tiết kiệm nước và hoá chất
entries.claim: Agricultural innovation allows farmers to produce more with fewer resources.
entries.because: Drip irrigation, sensors and better seeds deliver water and fertiliser exactly where plants need them, so yields rise while waste falls.
entries.result: Higher farm incomes strengthen rural communities and food supplies.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích đổi mới nông nghiệp / tập trung vào nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: An ninh lương thực, việc làm nông thôn, thu nhập xuất khẩu
entries.claim: A strong farming sector protects a country's food security.
entries.because: A country that grows its own food depends less on imports and is less exposed to price shocks, and farming provides jobs and export income in rural areas.
entries.result: Rural communities stay stable and fewer people move to crowded cities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của nông nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp đô thị: thực phẩm tươi tại chỗ, ít vận chuyển, dùng mái nhà và đất trống, gắn kết cộng đồng
entries.claim: Urban farming brings fresh food closer to the people who eat it.
entries.because: Rooftop gardens, vertical farms and community plots use empty space in cities, cut transport distances and give residents access to fresh vegetables.
entries.result: Local food costs less to deliver and strengthens community ties.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nông nghiệp đô thị / vườn cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp đô thị: sản lượng lương thực chính hạn chế, chi phí cao, thiếu đất và nước
entries.claim: Urban farms cannot grow enough staple crops to end food shortages.
entries.because: Cities lack the land and water needed for wheat, rice and maize, and high rents and energy costs make indoor farms expensive.
entries.result: Urban farming can supplement but not replace rural agriculture.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nông nghiệp đô thị (giới hạn).

entries.label_vi: Thuốc trừ sâu bảo vệ mùa màng, giữ năng suất, giá lương thực thấp
entries.claim: Pesticides protect crops from insects, weeds and disease.
entries.because: Without them farmers could lose a large share of their harvest, which would raise food prices and leave more people hungry.
entries.result: Food is cheaper and more reliably available.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thuốc trừ sâu.

entries.label_vi: Thuốc trừ sâu: dư lượng hại sức khoẻ, hại ong, nhiễm nguồn nước, sâu bệnh kháng thuốc
entries.claim: Pesticides can harm people, wildlife and water.
entries.because: Residues may stay on food, chemicals wash into rivers and kill useful insects such as bees, and pests gradually become resistant.
entries.result: Integrated pest management and careful use can reduce the harm.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thuốc trừ sâu (nhược điểm).

entries.label_vi: Nhãn nguồn gốc thực phẩm: người mua biết xuất xứ, an toàn, ủng hộ nông dân địa phương, chọn lựa đạo đức
entries.claim: Labels showing where food comes from help shoppers to make informed choices.
entries.because: Buyers can support local farmers, avoid products linked to poor safety records or long transport, and trace the source if a problem occurs.
entries.result: Producers have a reason to meet higher standards.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhãn sản phẩm / minh bạch.

entries.label_vi: Nông nghiệp hữu cơ: ít hoá chất, đất khoẻ, đa dạng sinh học; nhưng năng suất thấp, giá cao, cần nhiều đất
entries.claim: Organic farming reduces chemical use and protects soil and wildlife.
entries.because: Farmers avoid synthetic pesticides and fertilisers, which keeps soil healthy and supports biodiversity, although yields are lower and prices higher.
entries.result: Large-scale support may make sense only where benefits are clear.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu cho nông nghiệp hữu cơ.

entries.label_vi: Nước sạch: giảm bệnh, giúp trẻ (nhất là bé gái) đi học, tăng năng suất lao động
entries.claim: Clean water protects health and frees time for education and work.
entries.because: Safe drinking water prevents diseases such as diarrhoea, and families no longer spend hours collecting water, so children can attend school and adults can work.
entries.result: Healthier, better-educated people make the economy more productive.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nước sạch.

entries.text: A farmer who plants a drought-resistant variety, for example, may still harvest a reasonable crop in a dry year.
A farm that switches from flooding its fields to drip irrigation, for example, can grow the same crop with far less water.
A village that gains a safe tap, for example, sees fewer children miss school because of stomach illness, and girls no longer spend hours carrying water.

entries.label_vi: Động vật cảm nhận đau đớn; luật yếu cho phép tàn ác; luật mạnh đặt chuẩn tối thiểu và hình phạt
entries.claim: Animals can feel pain and fear, so they deserve legal protection.
entries.because: Weak laws allow cruelty on farms, in circuses and in laboratories, whereas strong laws set minimum standards of care and penalties for those who break them.
entries.result: Treatment of animals improves and public standards rise.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề luật bảo vệ động vật.

entries.label_vi: Luật bảo vệ động vật mạnh có lợi cho xã hội: giáo dục lòng nhân ái, thực phẩm an toàn hơn, du lịch
entries.claim: Stricter animal protection laws benefit society as well as animals.
entries.because: Respect for animals teaches children compassion, better conditions on farms reduce disease risks and improve food safety, and countries with good records attract responsible tourists.
entries.result: The cost to farmers can be reduced with time and support.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích xã hội của luật động vật.

entries.label_vi: Bảo tồn động vật hoang dã mang lại dịch vụ hệ sinh thái (thụ phấn, nước sạch, chống lũ), du lịch, thuốc
entries.claim: Wildlife conservation improves people's lives in practical ways.
entries.because: Healthy ecosystems pollinate crops, clean water and reduce floods, nature tourism creates jobs, and wild plants and animals provide the basis for new medicines.
entries.result: Communities near protected areas often gain income and a more reliable environment.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo tồn thiên nhiên / lợi ích cho con người.

entries.label_vi: Đại dương xuyên biên giới, cung cấp oxy và thực phẩm, điều hoà khí hậu; cần hợp tác quốc tế
entries.claim: The ocean is a shared resource that no single country can protect alone.
entries.because: Fish stocks, currents and pollution cross borders, the sea provides food for billions of people and helps to regulate the climate and produce oxygen.
entries.result: Overfishing and plastic waste in one region harm coastlines far away.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo vệ đại dương.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp không gian xanh đô thị: bảo vệ đất xanh, yêu cầu công viên trong dự án mới, mái xanh, cây đường phố, bảo trì
entries.claim: Governments can protect and expand green space inside cities.
entries.because: Planning rules can protect existing parks, require new developments to include gardens, and encourage green roofs and street trees where land is scarce.
entries.result: Residents gain cooler, cleaner and more pleasant surroundings.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cải thiện công viên / không gian xanh.

entries.label_vi: Vườn công cộng: sức khoẻ, làm mát, đa dạng sinh học, di sản, gắn kết; nhà ở có thể xây trên đất trống khác
entries.claim: Public gardens give city residents health, shade and a place to meet.
entries.because: They cool the air, absorb pollution, shelter birds and insects and offer free space to rest and exercise, and once built over they are almost impossible to replace.
entries.result: Housing can usually be built on empty or abandoned sites instead.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo vệ công viên / bãi biển khỏi phát triển.

entries.label_vi: Vườn cộng đồng: rau tươi, gắn kết, giáo dục, sức khoẻ tinh thần, tận dụng đất trống
entries.claim: Community gardens bring neighbours together and provide fresh food.
entries.because: Residents grow vegetables on unused land, share skills and tools, and meet people from different backgrounds, which also improves wellbeing.
entries.result: Neighbourhoods become cleaner, friendlier and safer.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề vườn cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Bãi biển công cộng: quyền tiếp cận bình đẳng, đụn cát chắn bão, du lịch bền vững; xây dựng làm tư nhân hoá và xói lở
entries.claim: Public beaches should stay open to everyone.
entries.because: Building along the shore privatises access, damages dunes that protect the coast from storms, disturbs wildlife and can speed up erosion.
entries.result: Well-managed beaches keep attracting visitors and income without permanent damage.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bảo tồn bãi biển khỏi phát triển.

entries.text: A law that bans tiny cages for hens, for example, forces producers to give animals room to move.
Bees that pollinate fruit trees, for example, help farmers to harvest more apples and almonds without any extra cost.
Fishing fleets that empty a region's waters, for example, leave coastal communities in other countries with fewer fish.
A block of flats with a planted roof, for example, stays cooler in summer and offers residents a small garden.
A vacant plot turned into a vegetable garden, for example, can become a place where neighbours meet instead of a spot where rubbish collects.

entries.label_vi: Sản phẩm thân thiện môi trường: ít ô nhiễm, thường bền hơn và tiết kiệm lâu dài, thúc đẩy doanh nghiệp
entries.claim: Environmentally friendly products reduce harm and often save money over time.
entries.because: They use less energy, create less waste and are often more durable, and growing demand encourages companies to improve their methods.
entries.result: A higher purchase price may be repaid through lower running costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sản phẩm xanh vs rẻ.

entries.label_vi: Sản phẩm rẻ: ngân sách gia đình có hạn, 'xanh' đôi khi chỉ là quảng cáo
entries.claim: Many households simply cannot afford to pay extra for green products.
entries.because: When budgets are tight, families have to choose the cheapest option, and some products labelled green make claims that are exaggerated or hard to check.
entries.result: Cheap alternatives remain popular unless prices fall or rules improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sản phẩm xanh vs rẻ.

entries.label_vi: Thời trang nhanh: sản xuất thừa, tốn nước, vải tổng hợp (vi nhựa), rác dệt may, điều kiện lao động kém
entries.claim: Fast fashion encourages people to buy more clothes than they need.
entries.because: Cheap, quickly changing styles lead to overproduction, high water and energy use, synthetic fibres that release microplastics, and large amounts of discarded clothing.
entries.result: The industry creates waste and pollution on a very large scale.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thời trang nhanh.

entries.label_vi: Tự làm / sửa chữa: kéo dài tuổi thọ đồ, giảm rác, tiết kiệm tiền, học kỹ năng
entries.claim: Do-it-yourself culture encourages people to repair and reuse instead of throwing away.
entries.because: Fixing a broken item, making furniture from old materials or sharing tools extends the life of products, saves money and teaches useful skills.
entries.result: Less waste is produced and fewer new goods have to be made.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề văn hoá tự làm / bền vững.

entries.label_vi: Tự làm có giới hạn: cần kỹ năng, thời gian, an toàn; quy mô nhỏ so với công nghiệp
entries.claim: The effect of do-it-yourself culture is limited.
entries.because: Not everyone has the skills, tools or time to repair things, some repairs are unsafe, and the largest environmental impacts come from industry and transport.
entries.result: It should complement, not replace, wider changes such as durable design.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của lập luận 'tự làm' / hành động cá nhân.

entries.label_vi: Nhãn tác động môi trường (carbon, nước, tái chế): người mua so sánh được, nhà sản xuất chịu áp lực cải thiện
entries.claim: Environmental impact labels help shoppers to compare products.
entries.because: A simple rating for carbon emissions, water use or recyclability lets buyers choose better options and puts pressure on producers to improve.
entries.result: Complicated or inconsistent labels, however, may confuse shoppers and add costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhãn sản phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông công cộng giảm phát thải trên mỗi hành khách, giảm kẹt xe
entries.claim: Public transport carries many people with far less pollution per passenger.
entries.because: A full bus or train replaces dozens of cars, which reduces exhaust fumes, congestion and the space needed for roads.
entries.result: Cities become cleaner and quieter when people can rely on frequent services.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông công cộng, ô nhiễm đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân ô nhiễm không khí thành phố công nghiệp: nhà máy, nhà máy điện than, giao thông, bụi xây dựng
entries.claim: Factories, coal power stations and traffic are the main causes of air pollution in industrial cities.
entries.because: They release smoke, dust and gases such as sulphur dioxide and nitrogen oxides, and the problem is worse when cities are crowded or surrounded by hills that trap polluted air.
entries.result: Residents suffer from breathing problems, and the cost of health care rises.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: giới hạn khí thải và bộ lọc, năng lượng sạch, giao thông sạch, giám sát và vành đai xanh
entries.claim: Strict emission limits and cleaner energy would reduce air pollution.
entries.because: Filters and emission limits cut what factories release, clean electricity replaces coal, and better public transport and electric vehicles reduce traffic fumes.
entries.result: Air quality monitoring and green belts help to track progress and absorb pollutants.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giải pháp ô nhiễm không khí.

entries.label_vi: Cách nhiệt nhà: tài trợ, vay lãi thấp, quy định cho nhà thuê, kiểm toán năng lượng miễn phí, giảm thuế
entries.claim: Governments can make home insulation cheaper and easier.
entries.because: Grants, low-interest loans and tax rebates remove the high upfront cost, rules for rented and new homes ensure minimum standards, and free energy checks show owners what to fix.
entries.result: Households save on heating bills and national emissions fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cách nhiệt, tiết kiệm năng lượng gia đình.

entries.text: An efficient light bulb, for example, may cost more at first but lasts much longer and uses far less electricity.
A cheap dress that is worn twice and then thrown away, for example, wastes the water and energy used to make it.
A neighbourhood repair cafe, for instance, lets residents mend toasters and bicycles together instead of buying replacements.
A city with many coal-burning factories in a valley, for example, may be covered in smog for weeks in winter.
A family that insulates its loft and walls, for example, may notice a clear fall in its heating bills within a single winter.

entries.label_vi: Cá nhân quyết định ăn gì, hút thuốc, tập luyện; nhiều bệnh lối sống có thể phòng ngừa
entries.claim: People make the daily choices that shape their own health.
entries.because: Nobody can eat, exercise or sleep on someone else's behalf, and many illnesses linked to diet, smoking and inactivity are largely preventable through sensible habits.
entries.result: Taking responsibility also respects personal freedom and encourages independence.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cá nhân vs chính phủ trong sức khoẻ.

entries.label_vi: Lựa chọn bị môi trường chi phối: đồ ăn rẻ, quảng cáo dày, thiếu thực phẩm tươi, thu nhập thấp, giờ làm dài
entries.claim: Individual choices are shaped by the environment in which people live.
entries.because: Cheap, heavily advertised, high-calorie food is available on every street, while fresh produce can be expensive or hard to find in poorer areas, and people on low incomes have little time or money to cook.
entries.result: Personal willpower alone cannot overcome these pressures.
entries.reuse_vi: Lập luận ủng hộ vai trò chính phủ trong sức khoẻ, béo phì.

entries.label_vi: Công cụ chính phủ: giáo dục, ghi nhãn, quy tắc quảng cáo, bữa ăn học đường, thuế, tiêm chủng, sàng lọc
entries.claim: Governments can make the healthy option the easy and affordable one.
entries.because: Education, clear labelling, advertising rules, school meal standards, taxes, vaccination and screening reach people on a scale that individuals cannot achieve.
entries.result: Health improves across the whole population, including those with the fewest resources.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chính phủ và sức khoẻ cộng đồng.

entries.label_vi: Thuế đồ ăn / uống không lành mạnh: tín hiệu giá, giảm tiêu thụ, nhà sản xuất giảm đường, nguồn thu cho y tế
entries.claim: A tax on unhealthy food and drink sends a clear price signal.
entries.because: Higher prices reduce consumption, encourage manufacturers to reduce sugar and fat, and raise revenue that can be spent on health services.
entries.result: Some countries that taxed sugary drinks saw sales fall and recipes change.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thuế đồ ăn không lành mạnh.

entries.label_vi: Thuế đánh nặng vào người nghèo, người ta chuyển sang món rẻ khác, giáo dục và tiếp cận tốt hơn
entries.claim: Taxes on food hit poorer households hardest.
entries.because: People on low incomes spend a larger share of their money on food, may simply switch to another cheap unhealthy product, and are not helped by a higher price alone.
entries.result: Education and better access to fresh food may achieve more.
entries.reuse_vi: Phản biện thuế thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Quán ăn nhanh gần trường: trẻ dễ bị tác động, rẻ và tiện, thói quen hình thành sớm; hạn chế giảm cám dỗ
entries.claim: Children are especially vulnerable to cheap, convenient fast food near their school.
entries.because: Young people have little money, little self-control and habits that are still forming, so an outlet at the school gate makes unhealthy eating the default.
entries.result: Restricting nearby outlets reduces temptation and supports school meal policies.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề quy định đồ ăn nhanh gần trường, béo phì trẻ em.

entries.label_vi: Chia sẻ chi phí y tế: bệnh tật bất ngờ và đắt, công bằng, chữa sớm rẻ hơn, lực lượng lao động khoẻ
entries.claim: Illness is unpredictable and expensive, so the cost of care should be shared.
entries.because: A serious illness can ruin a family's finances through no fault of its own, and people who delay treatment because they cannot pay often need costlier emergency care later.
entries.result: Public funding protects the poor and keeps the workforce healthy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi phí y tế, bảo hiểm, y tế tư nhân.

entries.text: A person who chooses fruit and water instead of biscuits and fizzy drinks, for example, lowers their own risk of illness without needing any law.
A child who is offered a nutritious school lunch every day, for instance, develops better habits without depending on family income.
A vaccination programme, for example, protects a whole community in a way that no individual could arrange alone.
Pupils who buy chips and fizzy drinks from a shop next to the school every lunchtime, for example, take in far more sugar and fat than they realise.

entries.label_vi: Y tế là nền tảng: dân ốm không học và làm việc được; dân số già cần chăm sóc; đại dịch cho thấy tầm quan trọng
entries.claim: Good health is the foundation on which everything else depends.
entries.because: A sick population cannot learn, work or care for children, ageing societies need more care each year, and emergencies such as pandemics show how quickly weak health systems fail.
entries.result: Spending on healthcare saves lives and protects the economy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu cho y tế, đầu tư vào y tế.

entries.label_vi: Nhà ở, giáo dục, môi trường cũng quyết định sức khoẻ; chỉ xây bệnh viện thì bỏ qua nguyên nhân
entries.claim: Many illnesses are caused by conditions that hospitals cannot change.
entries.because: Damp housing, poor education, pollution and poverty all damage health, so spending on housing, schools and clean air can reduce hospital visits.
entries.result: A narrow focus on treatment neglects the causes of illness.
entries.reuse_vi: Phản biện 'chỉ chi cho y tế'.

entries.label_vi: Bệnh tâm thần phổ biến, bị bỏ quên, chi phí ẩn (nghỉ việc, gia đình, tự tử); điều trị sớm rẻ hơn
entries.claim: Mental illness is common but often neglected.
entries.because: Conditions such as depression and anxiety are hidden, carry stigma and cost society through lost work, broken relationships and, in the worst cases, suicide, whereas early help is far cheaper than late treatment.
entries.result: Mental health deserves a larger share of spending than it usually receives.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sức khoẻ tâm thần.

entries.label_vi: Bệnh thể chất rõ ràng, đe doạ tính mạng, kết quả đo được; tâm trí cũng tốt hơn khi thể chất được chăm sóc
entries.claim: Physical illness is often more visible and immediately life-threatening.
entries.because: Cancer, heart disease and injuries need hospitals, equipment and trained staff at once, and their results are easier to measure, while mental health often improves when physical needs are met.
entries.result: Funding for physical care cannot be allowed to fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tâm thần vs thể chất.

entries.label_vi: Phòng bệnh rẻ hơn chữa bệnh: tiêm chủng, sàng lọc, chiến dịch, lối sống lành mạnh; lực lượng lao động khoẻ
entries.claim: Preventing illness is cheaper and kinder than treating it.
entries.because: Vaccination, screening and campaigns against smoking or poor diet stop disease before it starts, avoid suffering and keep people productive.
entries.result: Each unit of money spent on prevention saves several times as much on treatment later.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề phòng bệnh vs điều trị, chiến dịch sức khoẻ, sàng lọc.

entries.label_vi: Người đã ốm cần chữa ngay; không phòng được mọi thứ; cần bệnh viện, thiết bị, nhân lực
entries.claim: People who are already ill need treatment now.
entries.because: Campaigns cannot cure disease, accidents and genetic conditions cannot be prevented, and hospitals need modern buildings, equipment and staff to cope with emergencies and an ageing population.
entries.result: A health system that neglects treatment loses public trust.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi cho bệnh viện / điều trị.

entries.label_vi: Khuyến khích sinh: dân số già, lực lượng lao động giảm; nhưng đắt, hiệu quả không chắc
entries.claim: Birth rate initiatives are expensive and their results are uncertain.
entries.because: Childcare, parental leave and housing help may ease the pressure on young families, but people decide to have children for personal reasons and the effect of incentives is often small.
entries.result: Healthcare benefits everyone immediately, including the growing number of older people.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chính sách dân số.

entries.label_vi: Đầu tư y tế: dân khoẻ làm việc năng suất, ít nghỉ ốm, giảm chi phí dài hạn, ứng phó đại dịch, công bằng
entries.claim: Healthier people are more productive and cost less in the long run.
entries.because: A healthy workforce takes fewer sick days, supports economic growth and needs less expensive treatment later, and strong health services allow a country to respond quickly to epidemics.
entries.result: Health spending is an investment that repays itself.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của tập trung vào y tế.

entries.label_vi: Dịch vụ tâm thần miễn phí: bỏ rào cản chi phí, can thiệp sớm, năng suất, gia đình; nhưng tốn thuế, hàng chờ, thiếu nhân lực
entries.claim: Free mental health services remove the cost barrier to early treatment.
entries.because: Therapy and medication are expensive, so many people go without help until their condition becomes severe, while early support keeps them working and out of hospital.
entries.result: The main limits are the cost to taxpayers, long waiting lists and a shortage of trained staff.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề dịch vụ tâm thần miễn phí.

entries.text: A patient who waits two years for surgery, for example, may lose the ability to work and need far more care later.
Families living in damp homes, for example, suffer more asthma, so better housing can reduce visits to hospital.
An employee with untreated depression, for example, may be absent from work for months and strain relationships at home.
A heart patient who cannot get an operation, for instance, may die within weeks, whatever else the government spends on.
A campaign that teaches handwashing, for example, can reduce infections in schools at very little cost.
A rural hospital without a scanner, for instance, must send patients on long journeys that can delay diagnosis.

entries.label_vi: Y tế tư: chờ ngắn, chọn bác sĩ, cơ sở thoải mái, cạnh tranh thúc đẩy đổi mới, giảm tải cho hệ thống công
entries.claim: Private healthcare offers shorter waiting times and more choice.
entries.because: Patients who pay can often see a specialist within days, choose their doctor and enjoy comfortable facilities, and competition encourages clinics to adopt new equipment and improve service.
entries.result: The public system is relieved of some pressure because privately treated patients do not use its beds.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề y tế tư nhân, tư nhân hoá.

entries.label_vi: Y tế tư: bất bình đẳng hai tầng, lợi nhuận thúc đẩy xét nghiệm thừa, bỏ qua bệnh không sinh lời, hút bác sĩ khỏi hệ thống công
entries.claim: A profit-driven system can leave the poor behind.
entries.because: Those who can pay receive faster and better care while others wait, companies may encourage unnecessary tests or neglect conditions that make little profit, and private clinics can draw doctors away from public hospitals.
entries.result: Inequality in health grows and the public sector weakens.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm của y tế tư nhân.

entries.label_vi: Nằm viện ngắn: giảm chi phí, trống giường rút ngắn hàng chờ, ít nhiễm khuẩn bệnh viện, hồi phục tại nhà thoải mái, kỹ thuật mới
entries.claim: Shorter hospital stays lower costs and free beds for other patients.
entries.because: Modern techniques such as keyhole surgery and better pain relief allow earlier recovery, and patients at home avoid hospital infections and recover in comfort.
entries.result: Waiting lists fall and money is saved.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề xuất viện sớm, chi phí bệnh viện.

entries.label_vi: Rủi ro xuất viện sớm: biến chứng bị bỏ sót, nhập viện lại, người già sống một mình thiếu chăm sóc, gánh nặng cho người nhà
entries.claim: Patients sent home too early may suffer complications.
entries.because: Problems can go unnoticed without nurses nearby, older people who live alone may lack help, and family members often have to act as unpaid carers.
entries.result: Some patients return to hospital, which cancels out the savings.
entries.reuse_vi: Nhược điểm xuất viện sớm.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân khó tiếp cận y tế nông thôn: thiếu bác sĩ và cơ sở, đường xa, thu nhập thấp, người già nhiều
entries.claim: Rural areas struggle to attract doctors and keep clinics open.
entries.because: Medical staff often prefer cities for higher pay, better schools for their children and more career opportunities, while patients in the countryside face long journeys, poor roads and low incomes.
entries.result: People delay seeking help, and illnesses are found late.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tiếp cận y tế nông thôn.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: ưu đãi bác sĩ về nông thôn, đào tạo người địa phương, phòng khám lưu động, y tế từ xa, nhân viên y tế cộng đồng, đường sá
entries.claim: Governments should bring doctors and services closer to rural communities.
entries.because: Higher pay, housing and loan forgiveness attract staff, training local students encourages them to return, and mobile clinics, telemedicine and community health workers reach remote villages.
entries.result: Problems are found earlier and long journeys are avoided.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp y tế nông thôn.

entries.label_vi: Nước uống sạch: đường ống, giếng, nhà máy xử lý, sửa rò rỉ, bộ lọc giá rẻ, cộng đồng bảo trì, trợ giá cho hộ nghèo, giáo dục vệ sinh
entries.claim: Governments should invest in water infrastructure and keep it working.
entries.because: Pipes, wells and treatment plants bring safe water to homes, simple filters and community-run boreholes suit remote areas, and fixing leaks and testing quality protect supplies.
entries.result: Disease falls and families spend less time collecting water.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nước sạch, vệ sinh.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân vệ sinh kém ở khu ổ chuột: di cư nhanh, quá đông, định cư phi chính thức ngoài quy hoạch, nhà ở đắt, quản trị yếu
entries.claim: Rapid migration into cities outpaces the building of basic services.
entries.because: People who cannot afford housing settle in informal areas outside official planning, where there are no sewers, toilets or rubbish collection, and weak local governments lack the money or authority to provide them.
entries.result: Waste contaminates water and diseases spread easily.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khu ổ chuột, vệ sinh đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: nâng cấp hạ tầng (nhà vệ sinh, cống), công nhận pháp lý và quyền sử dụng đất, tham gia của cộng đồng, nhà ở giá rẻ, thu gom rác, giáo dục vệ sinh
entries.claim: Upgrading existing settlements is faster and fairer than clearing them.
entries.because: Toilets, drains and rubbish collection can be added step by step, legal recognition gives residents a reason to invest, and community participation keeps facilities clean and maintained.
entries.result: Health improves without forcing families to move.
entries.reuse_vi: Giải pháp vệ sinh đô thị.

entries.text: A patient who needs a knee replacement, for example, may be treated within weeks in a private hospital but wait a year in a public one.
A family without insurance, for example, may delay taking a sick child to a doctor until the illness becomes serious.
A patient who has a hip replacement and walks home within two days, for example, frees a bed for someone else on the waiting list.
A villager with chest pain, for example, may have to travel two hours to the nearest hospital, and many do not go at all.
In a settlement where hundreds of people share a few toilets, for example, waste can easily reach drinking water.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ giúp chẩn đoán sớm, chính xác (AI đọc ảnh, hồ sơ điện tử chia sẻ, robot phẫu thuật)
entries.claim: Technology helps doctors to diagnose illness earlier and more accurately.
entries.because: Computer programs can analyse scans in seconds, electronic records let specialists share information, and surgical robots allow smaller, more precise operations.
entries.result: Patients are treated sooner and recover faster.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ trong y tế.

entries.label_vi: Y tế từ xa: tiếp cận ở vùng xa, đỡ đi lại, rẻ, theo dõi bệnh mạn tính; giới hạn: cần internet, không khám trực tiếp, riêng tư
entries.claim: Telemedicine brings medical advice to people who cannot easily reach a clinic.
entries.because: Video consultations save travel time and cost, allow regular check-ups for chronic conditions and let rural patients consult city specialists.
entries.result: Its limits are the need for reliable internet, the lack of a physical examination and privacy concerns.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề y tế từ xa, y tế nông thôn.

entries.label_vi: Chỉnh sửa gen: chữa bệnh di truyền, liệu pháp nhắm đích; lo ngại đạo đức, chi phí, an toàn, bất bình đẳng
entries.claim: Gene editing could cure inherited diseases at their source.
entries.because: Scientists can already change faulty genes in blood and other cells, which may allow treatments for conditions such as sickle cell disease, but safety, cost and ethical questions remain.
entries.result: Strict rules and fair access will decide whether it benefits everyone.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chỉnh sửa gen.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ nano: đưa thuốc nhắm đích đến khối u, cảm biến siêu nhỏ, ít tác dụng phụ; còn sớm, an toàn chưa rõ, đắt
entries.claim: Nanotechnology could deliver drugs exactly where they are needed.
entries.because: Tiny particles can carry medicine directly to a tumour, sparing healthy tissue, and tiny sensors may detect disease much earlier.
entries.result: Side effects fall, but safety testing is slow and costs are high.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ nano trong y học.

entries.label_vi: Thiết bị đeo: theo dõi liên tục nhịp tim, đường huyết; cảnh báo sớm; bệnh nhân mạn tính quản lý tại nhà; hạn chế: độ chính xác, dữ liệu, riêng tư, chi phí
entries.claim: Wearable devices allow continuous monitoring outside hospital.
entries.because: Watches and patches record heart rate, blood sugar and sleep all day, warn of problems early and let patients with long-term illness manage their condition at home.
entries.result: Doctors gain more complete data, although accuracy, privacy and cost remain concerns.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thiết bị đeo, theo dõi bệnh nhân.

entries.label_vi: Thông tin y tế tự tìm trên mạng rủi ro: sai lệch, tự chẩn đoán gây lo âu hoặc chủ quan, tự chữa sai
entries.claim: Medical advice found online can be unreliable and risky.
entries.because: Websites and social media mix expert advice with rumour and advertising, and people who diagnose themselves may panic over minor symptoms or ignore serious ones.
entries.result: Online information is useful only when it comes from trusted sources and is checked with a professional.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thông tin y tế trên mạng.

entries.label_vi: Y học cổ truyền gần gũi, nhẹ nhàng, toàn diện nhưng thiếu bằng chứng; y học hiện đại được thử nghiệm, hiệu quả với bệnh nặng
entries.claim: Modern medicine is tested and proven, while traditional medicine often lacks evidence.
entries.because: Modern treatments such as vaccines, antibiotics and surgery are tested in trials and save lives, whereas many herbal remedies have not been properly studied, although some are gentle and culturally trusted.
entries.result: Traditional methods are best used alongside, not instead of, proven treatment.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề y học cổ truyền vs hiện đại.

entries.text: A program that checks thousands of chest scans, for example, can spot early signs of cancer that a tired doctor might miss.
A farmer who speaks to a heart specialist by video, for example, saves a day's travel and may receive advice weeks earlier.
A watch that detects an irregular heartbeat, for example, may prompt its wearer to see a doctor before a stroke occurs.
A person who searches online for the cause of a headache, for example, may be convinced that it is something deadly when it is only stress.

entries.label_vi: Thử nghiệm trên động vật góp phần tạo ra vaccine, insulin, kỹ thuật mổ; cơ thể sống phức tạp; thường là yêu cầu trước thử nghiệm trên người
entries.claim: Animal testing has contributed to many life-saving medical advances.
entries.because: Vaccines, insulin and surgical techniques were developed with the help of animal research, and a living body is so complex that a drug cannot be judged safe from isolated cells alone.
entries.result: Testing on animals first protects human volunteers from unknown dangers.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thử nghiệm động vật.

entries.label_vi: Động vật chịu đau khổ; kết quả không luôn áp dụng cho người; có phương án thay thế (mô nuôi cấy, mô hình máy tính, cơ quan thu nhỏ)
entries.claim: Animals suffer in experiments, and results do not always apply to people.
entries.because: Creatures that feel pain are confined and harmed for human benefit, and a drug that works safely in a mouse can fail in humans, while cell cultures, computer models and tiny lab-grown organs are improving.
entries.result: Many people argue that alternatives should replace animal tests wherever possible.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thử nghiệm động vật (phản đối).

entries.label_vi: Nguyên tắc 3R: thay thế, giảm số lượng, cải thiện điều kiện; luật chặt chẽ, kiểm tra độc lập
entries.claim: Animal research should follow the principles of replacing, reducing and refining.
entries.because: Scientists can replace animals with other methods where possible, use fewer animals, and treat those they use humanely under strict, independently inspected rules.
entries.result: Suffering is minimised while important research continues.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thử nghiệm động vật (giải pháp trung dung).

entries.label_vi: Sống lâu hơn: thêm thời gian cho gia đình, kinh nghiệm, đóng góp; thách thức: lương hưu, chi phí y tế, sa sút trí tuệ, cô đơn
entries.claim: Longer lives give people more time with their families and more time to contribute.
entries.because: Older people pass on experience, care for grandchildren and often keep working or volunteering, but ageing populations raise the cost of pensions and healthcare and increase dementia and loneliness.
entries.result: Societies must adapt through later retirement, better care and stronger communities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tuổi thọ dài hơn, dân số già.

entries.label_vi: Can thiệp giảm cân (phẫu thuật, thuốc, chương trình): giảm nguy cơ tiểu đường, tim; cải thiện vận động, tinh thần; rủi ro: chi phí, tác dụng phụ, tăng cân lại, rối loạn ăn uống
entries.claim: Weight-loss interventions can greatly reduce the risk of serious disease.
entries.because: Losing weight lowers the risk of diabetes, heart disease and joint problems and improves mobility, while surgery, drugs and structured programmes help people who have failed with dieting alone.
entries.result: Risks include cost, side effects, regaining weight and unhealthy attitudes to food.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm cân, béo phì.

entries.label_vi: Ăn chay: giảm nguy cơ tim mạch, tác động môi trường thấp, phúc lợi động vật; rủi ro thiếu B12, sắt, đạm; bất tiện xã hội
entries.claim: A well-planned vegetarian diet is good for health and the environment.
entries.because: People who eat more vegetables, fruit, beans and whole grains tend to have lower risks of heart disease, and producing plant foods generally uses less land, water and energy than producing meat, but vitamin B12, iron and protein need attention.
entries.result: The benefits depend on knowledge and careful planning.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chế độ ăn chay.

entries.text: A new drug for heart disease, for example, is usually tested on animals first to check for harmful effects before any person takes it.
A grandparent in good health, for example, can help to look after grandchildren and pass on knowledge, which supports working parents.
A patient with severe obesity who has stomach surgery, for example, may lose enough weight to control diabetes and walk without pain.

entries.label_vi: Đồ ăn nhanh: tiện, nhưng ít dinh dưỡng trên mỗi đồng, nhiều muối, đường, chất béo; chi phí sức khoẻ về sau
entries.claim: Fast food offers poor value for money once health is considered.
entries.because: A meal may be cheap and quick, but it usually contains a lot of salt, sugar and fat and little fibre, and regular eating raises the risk of obesity, diabetes and heart disease, which cost far more later.
entries.result: Cooking simple meals at home is usually cheaper and healthier.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đồ ăn nhanh.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân béo phì: lối sống ít vận động, thực phẩm rẻ giàu năng lượng, khẩu phần lớn, quảng cáo, đồ uống đường, căng thẳng và thiếu ngủ
entries.claim: Obesity is caused by an unhealthy balance between the energy people take in and the energy they use.
entries.because: Cheap, energy-dense food is easy to buy and heavily advertised, portions have grown, and modern life involves long hours of sitting at screens, desks and in cars.
entries.result: Stress, poor sleep and family habits can make the problem worse.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nguyên nhân béo phì.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp béo phì: bữa ăn học đường, giờ thể dục và vui chơi, hạn chế quảng cáo cho trẻ, thuế đường, giáo dục phụ huynh, khu vui chơi an toàn
entries.claim: Governments should make healthy eating and activity part of children's everyday lives.
entries.because: School meal standards, daily physical education, limits on advertising to children and safe play areas shape habits at an age when they are easiest to form.
entries.result: Fewer children become overweight, which saves healthcare costs later.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm béo phì trẻ em.

entries.label_vi: Ăn uống lành mạnh giảm nguy cơ bệnh tim, tiểu đường type 2, một số ung thư; nhưng không đảm bảo (gen, nhiễm trùng, tai nạn)
entries.claim: A healthy diet lowers the risk of many serious illnesses.
entries.because: Eating plenty of vegetables, fruit and whole grains and little processed food reduces the chance of heart disease, type 2 diabetes and some cancers, although genes, infections and accidents also play a part.
entries.result: Diet helps to prevent illness but cannot guarantee good health.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chế độ ăn và bệnh tật.

entries.label_vi: Chương trình dinh dưỡng trẻ em: lớn lên khoẻ, học tốt, đi học đều, giảm chi phí y tế dài hạn, phá vòng nghèo
entries.claim: Child nutrition programmes help children to grow, learn and stay healthy.
entries.because: Well-fed children concentrate better, attend school more regularly and suffer fewer illnesses, so they are more likely to finish their education and earn a good income.
entries.result: The programmes also break the cycle of poverty and reduce long-term healthcare costs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề dinh dưỡng trẻ em.

entries.label_vi: Nguyên nhân thanh thiếu niên lạm dụng chất: áp lực bạn bè, vấn đề gia đình, căng thẳng, tò mò, dễ mua, thiếu hiểu biết
entries.claim: Teenagers turn to drugs and alcohol because of peer pressure, stress and easy access.
entries.because: Friends who use substances make it seem normal, family problems and school pressure create a wish to escape, and curiosity combined with a lack of knowledge about the risks leads some young people to experiment.
entries.result: Early use can develop into addiction and damage health and education.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lạm dụng chất ở thanh thiếu niên.

entries.label_vi: Giải pháp: giáo dục về rủi ro, hỗ trợ gia đình và tư vấn, siết bán cho người chưa đủ tuổi, hoạt động thay thế, dịch vụ điều trị
entries.claim: Prevention should combine education, support and strict control of sales.
entries.because: Schools can explain the real risks, counselling helps teenagers with stress and family difficulties, enforcement stops shops selling to minors, and clubs and sport give young people healthy alternatives.
entries.result: Treatment services must be available for those who already have a problem.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lạm dụng chất / giải pháp.

entries.label_vi: Quy định an toàn thực phẩm chặt: giảm ngộ độc, lòng tin của người tiêu dùng; chi phí cho nhà sản xuất nhỏ, thực thi
entries.claim: Strict food safety rules protect public health.
entries.because: Inspections, hygiene standards and traceability reduce outbreaks of food poisoning and allow contaminated products to be recalled quickly, which builds trust in the food industry.
entries.result: The cost to small producers can be reduced by advice, time and proportionate rules.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề quy định an toàn thực phẩm.

entries.label_vi: Cấm hút thuốc nơi công cộng: giảm khói thuốc thụ động, giảm nhập viện, khuyến khích bỏ thuốc, thay đổi chuẩn mực
entries.claim: Smoking bans reduce exposure to harmful smoke and encourage people to quit.
entries.because: Second-hand smoke causes heart disease, lung disease and asthma among non-smokers, and when smoking is no longer allowed in public it becomes less normal and harder to continue.
entries.result: Hospital admissions for heart and breathing problems fall.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cấm hút thuốc.

entries.label_vi: Phản biện: tự do cá nhân, khó thực thi ngoài trời, quyền của người hút thuốc; khu vực chỉ định
entries.claim: A total ban limits personal freedom and may be difficult to enforce.
entries.because: Smoking is legal, many smokers are addicted rather than careless, and outdoor bans in open areas are hard to police.
entries.result: Designated outdoor areas can balance the rights of smokers and non-smokers.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn / nhượng bộ trong đề cấm hút thuốc.

entries.text: A family that eats takeaway meals every evening, for example, may spend twice as much as one that cooks simple dishes at home, and gain less nutrition.
A child who spends every evening on a games console and travels to school by car, for example, uses far less energy than children did in the past.
A school that serves fresh meals and gives every pupil a daily sports lesson, for instance, helps children to build habits that last into adulthood.
A child who receives a free school breakfast, for example, is less likely to feel tired and distracted in morning lessons.
A fifteen-year-old at a party where everyone is drinking, for example, may accept a drink simply to avoid being left out.
A restaurant that stores raw meat next to salad, for example, can cause an outbreak of food poisoning that affects dozens of customers.
A waiter who works eight hours a day in a smoky restaurant, for example, breathes in harmful smoke even though he has never smoked.

entries.label_vi: Chiến dịch y tế công cộng tiếp cận hàng triệu người với chi phí thấp, đổi thói quen (hút thuốc, rửa tay, tiêm chủng)
entries.claim: Public health campaigns reach millions of people at a low cost per person.
entries.because: Television, social media, schools and posters can spread simple, repeated messages about smoking, handwashing, vaccination or diet, and well-known figures and real stories make the advice memorable.
entries.result: Behaviour changes gradually and disease falls.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chiến dịch y tế, thay đổi hành vi.

entries.label_vi: Chiến dịch không đủ một mình: thông tin không đủ khi thiếu tiền, thời gian, dịch vụ; cần luật, giá, môi trường
entries.claim: Information alone does not change behaviour if people cannot act on it.
entries.because: People may know that vegetables are healthy but lack the money or time to buy them, and messages that lecture or frighten can be ignored.
entries.result: Campaigns work best when combined with services, rules and prices that support the advice.
entries.reuse_vi: Giới hạn của chiến dịch truyền thông.

entries.label_vi: Phát hiện bệnh sớm: điều trị sớm, tỷ lệ sống cao hơn, rẻ hơn, lực lượng lao động khoẻ
entries.claim: Detecting disease early makes treatment simpler, cheaper and more successful.
entries.because: Screening for cancer, diabetes and heart disease finds problems before symptoms appear, when a small operation or medicine may be enough, whereas late discovery needs long and costly care.
entries.result: More people survive and stay productive, and health budgets are saved.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề phát hiện bệnh sớm, sàng lọc.

entries.label_vi: Hỗ trợ tâm thần nơi làm việc: luật giới hạn khối lượng việc, tư vấn miễn phí, đào tạo quản lý, giờ linh hoạt, giảm kỳ thị, ưu đãi doanh nghiệp
entries.claim: Governments should require and encourage mentally healthy workplaces.
entries.because: Laws on working hours and workload, free counselling, training for managers, flexible hours and campaigns against stigma help employees to cope before stress becomes illness.
entries.result: Staff are absent less often and productivity improves.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sức khoẻ tâm thần nơi làm việc.

entries.label_vi: Trị liệu bằng nghệ thuật: kênh biểu đạt khi khó nói thành lời, giảm căng thẳng, tăng tự tin; bổ trợ chứ không thay thế thuốc, trị liệu nói chuyện
entries.claim: Arts therapy gives people a way to express feelings that they cannot put into words.
entries.because: Painting, music and drama allow patients to explore painful experiences safely, reduce stress and build confidence, which helps those who find talking therapy difficult.
entries.result: It works best alongside, not instead of, medication and counselling.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nghệ thuật trị liệu.

entries.label_vi: Sức khoẻ kém dẫn đến nghèo, thất nghiệp, nợ, căng thẳng gia đình; nhưng vấn đề xã hội còn do bất bình đẳng, giáo dục, thất nghiệp
entries.claim: Poor health can trigger a chain of social problems.
entries.because: Illness reduces the ability to work and earn, leads to debt and family stress, and may cause isolation or substance abuse, yet inequality, weak education and unemployment also cause social problems independently.
entries.result: Health is a major cause, not the only one.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sức khoẻ và vấn đề xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Luật môi trường nghiêm hơn giảm bệnh hô hấp, tim; nước sạch; ví dụ cấm xăng pha chì
entries.claim: Stricter environmental laws protect people from pollution-related disease.
entries.because: Limits on factory and vehicle emissions and on contaminated water reduce asthma, heart disease and infections, and removing lead from petrol lowered lead poisoning in children.
entries.result: Fewer people need hospital treatment, although costs and enforcement must be managed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề luật môi trường và sức khoẻ.

entries.text: A campaign that shows the real story of a former smoker, for example, can persuade more people to quit than a list of statistics.
A woman whose breast cancer is found at a routine scan, for example, may need only a small operation and be back at work within weeks.
An employee who is expected to answer emails late at night, for example, may develop anxiety long before anyone notices.
A child who cannot speak about a frightening experience, for example, may be able to show it through drawing.
A father who falls ill and cannot work, for example, may plunge his family into debt and stress.
