entries.label_vi: Khoa học công nghệ cải thiện cuộc sống: y tế, giao tiếp, hiệu quả, tiếp cận thông tin; mặt trái: mất việc, riêng tư, phụ thuộc, ô nhiễm
entries.claim: Science and technology have raised living standards in health, communication and convenience.
entries.because: Vaccines and medical devices save lives, the internet and mobile networks connect people instantly, and machines make work and housework faster, although they can also cause job losses, dependence and pollution.
entries.result: The balance depends on how societies manage change.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khoa học công nghệ cải thiện hay gây vấn đề.

entries.label_vi: Lợi ích quốc gia tập trung công nghệ/đổi mới/khoa học: tăng trưởng, việc làm kỹ năng cao, cạnh tranh, dịch vụ hiệu quả; nghiên cứu: kiến thức, thuốc, giải quyết vấn đề toàn cầu
entries.claim: A country that invests in technology and research becomes more productive and competitive.
entries.because: High-tech industries create well-paid jobs and exports, digital services make government and business more efficient, and basic research produces medicines, materials and ideas that solve global problems.
entries.result: The gains are long-term and spread across the economy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích của công nghệ, đổi mới, khoa học nghiên cứu.

entries.label_vi: Internet chỉ khuếch đại vấn đề xã hội (bắt nạt mạng, tin giả, cô lập), nguyên nhân gốc là kinh tế, gia đình, giáo dục
entries.claim: The internet magnifies social problems but rarely creates them.
entries.because: Bullying, misinformation and isolation existed before, and the internet makes them faster and more visible, while the underlying causes are poverty, family breakdown and weak education.
entries.result: Solving the problems requires tackling those causes as well as regulating online behaviour.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề internet và vấn đề xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Tự động hoá: loại việc nguy hiểm, nhàm chán, tăng năng suất, hàng rẻ; nhưng mất việc, bất bình đẳng; cần đào tạo lại
entries.claim: Automation removes dangerous and repetitive work and makes goods cheaper.
entries.because: Machines handle heavy lifting, hazardous chemicals and repetitive assembly, raising productivity and lowering prices, although workers whose jobs disappear need retraining and support.
entries.result: Living standards rise when the gains are shared.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tự động hoá.

entries.label_vi: Điện thoại thông minh: giao tiếp, thông tin, bản đồ, ngân hàng, an toàn; nhưng xao nhãng, nghiện, riêng tư
entries.claim: Smartphones put communication, information and services in everyone's pocket.
entries.because: People can contact family, find directions, bank, shop and call for help from one device, though constant notifications, dependence and loss of privacy are real costs.
entries.result: Their value depends on how disciplined users are.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề điện thoại thông minh cải thiện cuộc sống.

entries.label_vi: Ứng dụng tăng năng suất: quản lý nhiệm vụ, tự động hoá, cộng tác, tiết kiệm thời gian; nhưng thông báo gây xao nhãng
entries.claim: Mobile apps save time by organising, automating and connecting work.
entries.because: Calendars, task lists, shared documents and messaging remove delays and paperwork, while notifications and endless features can distract and reduce real output.
entries.result: Productivity improves when people choose a few tools and switch off interruptions.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ứng dụng di động và năng suất.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ giảm tiếp xúc trực tiếp (điện thoại ở bàn ăn) nhưng cũng giúp giữ liên lạc, hẹn gặp
entries.claim: Technology can reduce face-to-face contact, yet it also helps people to meet.
entries.because: Time spent on screens can replace conversation, but messaging, video calls and social networks keep distant friends in touch and help people arrange meetings.
entries.result: The outcome depends on whether devices replace or support personal contact.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ và tiếp xúc trực tiếp.

entries.label_vi: Ứng dụng chỉnh ảnh tạo chuẩn đẹp phi thực tế: lọc, so sánh, hình ảnh cơ thể, người trẻ; nhận thức và quy định ghi nhãn
entries.claim: Photo editing apps make unrealistic images look normal.
entries.because: Filters smooth skin, change shapes and brighten features so well that edited faces seem real, and young people who compare themselves with them may feel dissatisfied with their own bodies.
entries.result: Education about editing and clear labelling can reduce the harm.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ứng dụng chỉnh ảnh, chuẩn đẹp.

entries.label_vi: Thực phẩm biến đổi gen có lợi: năng suất, dinh dưỡng, giảm thuốc trừ sâu; cần quy định, nhãn, kiểm nghiệm
entries.claim: Genetically modified food can be beneficial when it is regulated and tested.
entries.because: Modified crops can resist disease, survive drought and carry extra nutrients, which raises yields and reduces chemical use, while independent testing and clear labels address safety and trust.
entries.result: Benefits are greatest where food is scarce.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thực phẩm biến đổi gen.

entries.text: A villager who consults a city doctor by video, for example, receives expert advice without travelling for hours.
A country that allows citizens to file taxes and vote online, for example, saves time and money for both government and residents.
A false rumour about a neighbour, for example, once spread slowly by gossip but can now reach thousands in minutes.
A robot that welds car parts, for example, protects workers from fumes and produces more consistent results.
A traveller who is lost in an unfamiliar city, for example, can find the way, translate a menu and call a taxi with one phone.
A team that uses a shared calendar and chat app, for example, can arrange a meeting in minutes instead of exchanging dozens of emails.
A family that scrolls through phones at dinner, for example, shares the same table but not the same conversation.
A teenager who edits every selfie to make her skin flawless, for example, may start to believe that her real face is unattractive.
A rice variety enriched with vitamin A, for example, could help to prevent blindness in children whose diet lacks it.

entries.label_vi: Quyền riêng tư số: cá nhân (cài đặt, mật khẩu, cân nhắc chia sẻ); công ty và chính phủ (luật bảo vệ dữ liệu, tiêu chuẩn, phạt)
entries.claim: Digital privacy needs both careful users and strong protection from companies and governments.
entries.because: Individuals can check settings, use strong passwords and think before sharing, but only laws and standards can limit how organisations collect, store and sell personal data.
entries.result: Neither side can protect privacy alone.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề quyền riêng tư số, cá nhân vs chính phủ.

entries.label_vi: Sức khoẻ số: cá nhân tự đặt giới hạn, tắt thông báo; nền tảng thiết kế gây nghiện nên cần điều tiết, giáo dục, bảo vệ trẻ
entries.claim: Digital wellbeing depends on personal habits but is shaped by how products are designed.
entries.because: Users can set limits and switch off alerts, yet many apps are built to hold attention for as long as possible, so rules on design, protection for children and education about healthy use are also needed.
entries.result: Responsibility is shared between users, companies and governments.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sức khoẻ số.

entries.label_vi: Phòng chống tội phạm mạng: cá nhân (cập nhật phần mềm, cảnh giác lừa đảo); ngân hàng, công ty bảo mật; chính phủ luật, cảnh sát chuyên môn, hợp tác quốc tế
entries.claim: Preventing cybercrime needs careful users, secure organisations and international law enforcement.
entries.because: People can update software and avoid suspicious links, but criminals operate across borders, so banks and companies must secure systems and governments must pursue offenders together.
entries.result: Weak links at any level can undo the others.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tội phạm mạng.

entries.label_vi: Quyền riêng tư trực tuyến đang biến mất: thu thập dữ liệu, theo dõi, camera; nhưng luật và công cụ bảo vệ
entries.claim: Online privacy is shrinking because almost every action leaves a data trail.
entries.because: Websites, apps and devices track what people search, buy and where they go, companies sell the profiles, and few users read the terms they accept, although privacy laws and tools can limit the loss.
entries.result: Privacy now has to be actively defended.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề quyền riêng tư trực tuyến.

entries.label_vi: Ẩn danh: khuyến khích hành vi xấu (quấy rối, troll) vì không sợ chịu trách nhiệm; nhưng bảo vệ người tố giác, người bị đàn áp, riêng tư
entries.claim: Anonymity can encourage bad behaviour, but it also protects people who need it.
entries.because: People who cannot be identified feel free to insult and harass others, yet whistleblowers, victims of abuse and citizens in repressive states depend on anonymity to speak safely.
entries.result: Rules should punish abuse without removing safe ways to speak.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ẩn danh trực tuyến.

entries.label_vi: Giám sát của chính phủ: ngăn khủng bố và tội phạm, cứu mạng; nhưng xâm phạm quyền riêng tư, lạm quyền; cần luật, giám sát độc lập, nhắm mục tiêu
entries.claim: Surveillance can prevent serious crime but threatens freedom when it is unchecked.
entries.because: Monitoring communications and movements helps police to stop terrorism and organised crime, yet mass collection invades privacy, can be misused against critics and may make citizens afraid to speak.
entries.result: Targeted powers with court approval and independent oversight balance safety and liberty.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giám sát của chính phủ.

entries.label_vi: Camera giám sát nơi công cộng: răn đe, bằng chứng, an toàn; nhưng riêng tư, tốn kém, tội phạm dịch chuyển, nhận diện sai
entries.claim: Surveillance cameras can deter crime and provide evidence but raise privacy and cost concerns.
entries.because: Visible cameras discourage theft and help police to identify offenders, yet they record innocent people, are costly to run, may only move crime elsewhere and can misidentify faces.
entries.result: Cameras work best in high-risk places with clear rules on use and storage.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề camera giám sát.

entries.label_vi: ID sinh trắc học: an ninh cao, chống gian lận, tiện lợi; nhưng riêng tư, rò rỉ dữ liệu không thể đổi, sai sót, loại trừ
entries.claim: Biometric identification is secure and convenient but carries lasting privacy risks.
entries.because: Fingerprints and faces are hard to forge and speed up checks at borders and banks, yet a stolen fingerprint cannot be changed, databases attract hackers and errors can wrongly exclude people.
entries.result: Strong data protection and fair alternatives are essential.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hệ thống ID sinh trắc học.

entries.label_vi: Số hoá hồ sơ công: dễ tiếp cận, nhanh, tiết kiệm, bảo quản; nhưng riêng tư, an ninh, khoảng cách số, chi phí, lỗi thời định dạng
entries.claim: Digitising public records makes them easier to find and preserve but creates new risks.
entries.because: Citizens can search archives and obtain documents online, paper is saved and fragile records are protected, yet large databases attract hackers, expose personal data and exclude people without internet access.
entries.result: Security and alternative access routes are needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề số hoá hồ sơ công.

entries.label_vi: Khoảng cách số: nguyên nhân: chi phí, hạ tầng nông thôn, kỹ năng; giải pháp: trợ cấp thiết bị và gói cước, wifi công cộng, đào tạo kỹ năng, mở rộng cáp quang, chương trình trường học
entries.claim: The digital divide comes from cost, poor infrastructure and lack of skills, and each cause needs its own remedy.
entries.because: Families on low incomes cannot afford devices or data, rural areas lack cables and signals, and many older people have never been taught to use online services.
entries.result: Subsidies, public wifi, network expansion and training narrow the gap.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khoảng cách số.

entries.label_vi: Internet tốc độ cao công bằng: đầu tư mạng ở nông thôn, cạnh tranh và điều tiết giá, nghĩa vụ dịch vụ phổ cập, gói cước giá rẻ, chia sẻ hạ tầng
entries.claim: Governments should treat fast internet as essential infrastructure.
entries.because: Companies avoid sparsely populated areas because they are unprofitable, so public funding, shared networks, price regulation and low-cost plans are needed to bring fast service to rural and poorer households.
entries.result: Equal access lets everyone work, study and use public services online.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề truy cập internet tốc độ cao công bằng.

entries.text: A user who reviews the privacy settings of an app, for example, can stop it from sharing her location with advertisers.
A video app that starts the next clip automatically, for example, makes it easy to lose an hour without deciding to.
A person who ignores a software update, for example, may leave a gap that criminals use to steal data.
A shopper who searches for a pair of shoes, for example, may see advertisements for them on a dozen unrelated websites.
A user with a false name who insults strangers, for example, behaves in a way that he would never dare to in person.
Police who need a court order before reading a suspect's messages, for example, can investigate serious crime without spying on everyone.
A camera that covers a poorly lit car park, for example, helps police to identify thieves and makes drivers feel safer.
A traveller who passes an automatic border gate with a fingerprint scan, for example, saves time but leaves personal data in a government database.
A citizen who orders a birth certificate online, for example, avoids a journey to a distant office.
A student without internet at home, for example, can do homework at a library that offers free computers and wifi.
A village that receives fast broadband, for example, allows a small business to sell its products online and children to study with the same tools as city pupils.

entries.label_vi: Thám hiểm vũ trụ thúc đẩy tiến bộ: công nghệ phái sinh (vệ tinh, vật liệu, y tế), khoa học, cảm hứng, bảo vệ Trái Đất
entries.claim: Space exploration drives technology and knowledge that benefit people on Earth.
entries.because: Missions require advances in materials, medicine, communications and computing that later spread to everyday use, and satellites provide weather forecasts, navigation and climate data.
entries.result: Spending on space produces practical returns.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thám hiểm vũ trụ.

entries.label_vi: Thám hiểm vũ trụ tốn kém: tiền có thể dùng cho y tế, giáo dục, nghèo đói; rủi ro; lợi ích xa vời
entries.claim: Space programmes cost enormous sums that could address urgent problems on Earth.
entries.because: Missions run to billions, with uncertain returns, while hospitals, schools and housing lack funds, and failures waste money and sometimes lives.
entries.result: Critics say priorities should lie with immediate needs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi phí thám hiểm vũ trụ.

entries.label_vi: VR thay đổi giải trí: trò chơi, phim, du lịch ảo, sự kiện trực tiếp; nhưng giá, buồn nôn, thiếu nội dung, tách biệt xã hội, vẫn bổ sung hơn thay thế
entries.claim: Virtual reality will change entertainment in gaming and live events but will not replace traditional forms.
entries.because: Headsets offer immersion that screens cannot, yet cost, motion sickness and limited content keep many people away, and people still enjoy sharing cinemas, concerts and television.
entries.result: VR will be an important addition, not a complete replacement.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề VR và giải trí.

entries.label_vi: Thiết bị đeo theo dõi sức khoẻ: nhịp tim, giấc ngủ, phát hiện sớm, bệnh mãn tính; nhưng độ chính xác, lo lắng quá mức, riêng tư, bất bình đẳng
entries.claim: Wearable devices will make health monitoring continuous and personal, though accuracy and privacy limit their role.
entries.because: Sensors track heart rate, sleep and activity all day and can alert users and doctors early, but readings are sometimes unreliable, can cause needless anxiety and produce data that companies may misuse.
entries.result: Wearables will support, not replace, medical care.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thiết bị đeo và sức khoẻ.

entries.label_vi: Blockchain và ngân hàng: chuyển tiền nhanh rẻ, sổ cái minh bạch, hợp đồng thông minh; nhưng quy định, biến động, năng lượng, ngân hàng thích nghi
entries.claim: Blockchain will change parts of banking, mainly payments and record keeping, without removing banks.
entries.because: Shared ledgers allow faster and cheaper transfers across borders and reduce the need for intermediaries, but regulation, security concerns and the need for trust mean banks will adopt the technology rather than disappear.
entries.result: Change will be significant but gradual.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề blockchain và ngân hàng.

entries.label_vi: Robot giao hàng tự động: giảm chi phí, giao nhanh, ít khí thải; nhưng vỉa hè đông, thời tiết, trộm, mất việc, quy định; phổ biến ở khu vực phù hợp
entries.claim: Delivery robots will become common in suitable areas but not everywhere.
entries.because: They cut labour costs and emissions on short trips, yet crowded pavements, bad weather, theft and safety rules limit where they can operate, and they threaten jobs for couriers.
entries.result: Use will grow in campuses and suburbs rather than dense old cities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề robot giao hàng.

entries.label_vi: Máy tính lượng tử và công nghiệp: mô phỏng thuốc và vật liệu, tối ưu hậu cần, mật mã; nhưng còn sớm, lỗi, tốn kém, chỉ dùng chuyên biệt
entries.claim: Quantum computers will transform a few industries but remain specialised tools.
entries.because: They can simulate molecules and solve some optimisation problems far faster than ordinary machines, helping drug and materials research, but errors, cost and the need for extreme cooling restrict them to special tasks.
entries.result: Wider effects within twenty years are likely to be limited to specialist fields.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề máy tính lượng tử.

entries.label_vi: Trợ cấp xe điện: giảm khí thải, giảm giá ban đầu, thúc đẩy sản xuất; nhưng ưu đãi người giàu, tốn ngân sách, nên có thời hạn và hạ tầng sạc
entries.claim: Subsidies for electric vehicles are justified when temporary and well targeted.
entries.because: Buyers face high prices and a lack of chargers, so support speeds up adoption and cuts emissions, but unlimited grants mostly benefit wealthy households and cost public money that could improve public transport.
entries.result: Time-limited, income-based subsidies with charging investment work best.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề trợ cấp xe điện.

entries.label_vi: Chi tiêu cho nghiên cứu hay dịch vụ công: nghiên cứu mang lại lợi ích dài hạn, kinh tế; dịch vụ công đáp ứng nhu cầu cấp thiết (y tế, giáo dục); cần cân bằng
entries.claim: Governments should fund services first but keep research as a long-term investment.
entries.because: Hospitals, schools and welfare meet urgent needs and cannot wait, while research produces discoveries, jobs and growth that pay for future services.
entries.result: A balanced budget serves both present and future needs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ngân sách nghiên cứu vs dịch vụ công.

entries.label_vi: Hạ tầng số hay truyền thống: số: tăng trưởng, dịch vụ trực tuyến, làm việc từ xa; truyền thống: đường, cầu, điện, nước là nền tảng; cần cả hai
entries.claim: Digital networks depend on traditional infrastructure, so spending should balance the two.
entries.because: Fast internet supports remote work, online services and business growth, but it needs reliable electricity, roads and water to function, and neglected basic infrastructure harms everyday life and safety.
entries.result: Priority should depend on each region's biggest gap.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hạ tầng số vs truyền thống.

entries.label_vi: Khoa học công dân: nhiều dữ liệu, chi phí thấp, phạm vi địa lý rộng, tăng hiểu biết và tham gia của công chúng; hạn chế: chất lượng dữ liệu, cần hướng dẫn
entries.claim: Citizen science benefits research by supplying large amounts of data at low cost and involving the public.
entries.because: Thousands of volunteers can record observations over wide areas and long periods that scientists could not cover, and taking part builds public understanding, although training and checking are needed to keep quality high.
entries.result: Research becomes broader, cheaper and more trusted.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khoa học công dân.

entries.text: A farmer who receives a satellite weather forecast, for example, can decide when to plant and avoid losing a crop.
The sum spent on a single mission, for example, could equip dozens of hospitals in poorer regions.
A fan who cannot travel, for example, can watch a concert in virtual reality as if standing near the stage.
A smartwatch that notices an irregular heartbeat, for example, can advise its owner to see a doctor before a serious problem develops.
A worker abroad who sends money home, for example, may pay high fees and wait days, whereas a blockchain transfer can arrive within minutes at lower cost.
A small robot that brings lunch to students across a university campus, for example, works well on wide, quiet paths.
A drug company that can simulate how a molecule behaves, for example, may find a new medicine in months instead of years.
A family on a modest income, for example, may only buy an electric car if a grant lowers its price.
Years of earlier research, for example, allowed scientists to develop vaccines quickly when a new virus appeared.
A town with fast broadband but frequent power cuts, for example, still cannot support online businesses.
Thousands of volunteers who record the birds in their gardens, for example, give scientists a picture of population changes that no small team could collect.

entries.label_vi: Thất nghiệp: do tự động hoá, suy thoái, kỹ năng không khớp; nhưng tuỳ nước và thời kỳ; giải pháp đào tạo lại, tạo việc làm
entries.claim: Unemployment is a serious problem where skills do not match available jobs, though it varies by country and period.
entries.because: Automation, economic slowdowns and a gap between education and employer needs leave many people without work, especially the young, but retraining and job creation can reduce it.
entries.result: Policy matters more than the trend itself.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thất nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Làm việc từ xa: linh hoạt, tiết kiệm đi lại, tuyển nhân tài rộng; nhưng cô lập, khó phối hợp, ranh giới công việc nhà mờ
entries.claim: Remote work saves time and widens opportunity but can isolate staff and weaken teamwork.
entries.because: Workers avoid commuting and can live anywhere, and firms recruit from a wider pool, yet loneliness, weaker collaboration and blurred limits between work and home may reduce wellbeing and creativity.
entries.result: Hybrid arrangements often work best.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm việc từ xa.

entries.label_vi: AI thay đổi nơi làm việc: tự động hoá việc lặp lại, hỗ trợ quyết định, nghề mới; nhưng mất việc, cần đào tạo lại, con người vẫn cần ở sáng tạo, chăm sóc
entries.claim: Artificial intelligence will change many tasks but will not replace human work entirely.
entries.because: It automates routine and data-heavy tasks and creates new roles, yet jobs that need creativity, judgement and personal care remain human, and workers must be retrained as roles change.
entries.result: The workplace will be reshaped rather than emptied.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề AI và nơi làm việc.

entries.label_vi: Công ty lớn: lương, phúc lợi, đào tạo, ổn định; công ty nhỏ: trách nhiệm rộng, quan hệ gần gũi, linh hoạt, thăng tiến nhanh
entries.claim: Large firms offer security and benefits, while small firms offer variety and closer relationships.
entries.because: Big companies pay well, train staff and rarely collapse, but employees can feel like small cogs, whereas small businesses give wider responsibility, faster promotion and a friendly atmosphere with less stability.
entries.result: The best choice depends on personality and career stage.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công ty lớn vs nhỏ.

entries.label_vi: Kế hoạch hưu trí: cá nhân tiết kiệm sớm, đầu tư; chính phủ lương hưu cơ bản, bảo vệ người thu nhập thấp; kết hợp
entries.claim: Retirement security needs both personal saving and a public pension.
entries.because: People who save early and invest wisely gain independence, but low earners, carers and the self-employed often cannot save enough, so the state must guarantee a basic pension.
entries.result: Shared responsibility protects everyone in old age.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hưu trí.

entries.label_vi: Làm tự do: tự chủ, thu nhập tiềm năng, linh hoạt; nhưng không ổn định, không phúc lợi, tự lo thuế và hưu trí
entries.claim: Freelancing improves life for those who value independence but removes security.
entries.because: Freelancers choose clients, hours and place, and can earn more, yet income is uneven, and they receive no sick pay or pension and must find work constantly.
entries.result: It suits skilled and confident workers rather than everyone.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm tự do.

entries.label_vi: Giờ làm dài: tăng sản lượng, thu nhập; nhưng kiệt sức, giảm hiệu quả, sức khoẻ, gia đình
entries.claim: Longer working hours raise output only briefly and carry heavy human costs.
entries.because: Extra hours bring more pay and production, but tired workers make errors, suffer stress and illness, and have little time for family, so productivity per hour falls.
entries.result: Shorter, focused hours are often more efficient.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giờ làm dài.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ tăng năng suất: tự động hoá, truyền thông nhanh, phân tích dữ liệu; nhưng xao nhãng, cần kỹ năng
entries.claim: Technology raises productivity by speeding up tasks and communication.
entries.because: Software, machines and data tools let workers do more in less time, although distractions and the need for training can reduce the gain.
entries.result: Output per worker has grown in most industries.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ và năng suất.

entries.label_vi: Khu vực công: ổn định, lương hưu, giờ cố định, ý nghĩa xã hội; tư nhân: lương cao hơn, thăng tiến nhanh, cạnh tranh, rủi ro
entries.claim: Public jobs offer security, while private jobs offer higher pay and faster advancement.
entries.because: Government posts bring steady hours, pensions and a sense of public service, but private firms reward performance, pay more and give rapid promotion at the price of insecurity.
entries.result: Preference depends on attitude to risk.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công vs tư.

entries.label_vi: Kinh tế gig: linh hoạt, dễ vào nghề; nhưng không hợp đồng, không phúc lợi, thu nhập bất định, thuật toán kiểm soát; cần luật bảo vệ
entries.claim: The gig economy weakens job security by replacing contracts with short tasks.
entries.because: Platforms offer quick access to work, yet drivers and couriers have no sick pay or guaranteed hours, can be removed by an algorithm and bear all costs themselves.
entries.result: Regulation should give gig workers basic protections.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề gig economy.

entries.label_vi: Cân bằng công việc – cuộc sống: sức khoẻ, hiệu quả, gia đình; giờ dài thể hiện cam kết nhưng không phải thước đo năng suất
entries.claim: Work-life balance protects health and performance, and long hours do not prove commitment.
entries.because: Rested employees concentrate better and stay longer in a job, while those who work excessively burn out, so results matter more than hours present.
entries.result: Firms gain from respecting private time.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cân bằng cuộc sống.

entries.label_vi: Ổn định nghề nghiệp: lương đều, chuyên môn sâu, kế hoạch dài hạn; linh hoạt: thích nghi, kỹ năng đa dạng, cơ hội mới, ít nhàm chán
entries.claim: Stability gives security and expertise, while flexibility gives adaptability and fresh opportunity.
entries.because: A steady career brings regular income, deep skills and the confidence to plan, but those who change jobs learn many skills, adapt when industries decline and avoid boredom.
entries.result: A mixture, such as stable core skills with willingness to change, suits a fast-changing economy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ổn định hay linh hoạt nghề nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Nhà tuyển dụng đào tạo nhân viên mới: nhanh thạo việc, giảm lỗi, giữ chân, văn hoá công ty; nhưng chi phí, nhân viên có thể nghỉ; chia sẻ với giáo dục
entries.claim: Employers should train new workers because it makes them productive and loyal.
entries.because: Schools cannot teach every company procedure, so training reduces mistakes and raises confidence, and staff who feel invested in stay longer, although small firms may need public support for the cost.
entries.result: Training is an investment that repays itself.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đào tạo nhân viên mới.

entries.label_vi: Ca sáng: hợp nhịp sinh học, tối rảnh cho gia đình; ca tối: tránh giờ cao điểm, trả thêm, buổi sáng rảnh; nhưng ảnh hưởng giấc ngủ, xã hội
entries.claim: Morning shifts fit the body clock and family life, while evening shifts suit those who want free mornings and extra pay.
entries.because: Most people sleep and eat better on day schedules and have evenings with family, yet evening workers avoid rush-hour traffic, may earn allowances and can use the morning for study or errands.
entries.result: Preference depends on personality and responsibilities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ca sáng vs tối.

entries.label_vi: Làm việc tại nhà với gia đình: thời gian với con, tiết kiệm đi lại, linh hoạt; nhưng mất tập trung, ranh giới, căng thẳng, thiếu không gian
entries.claim: Working from home gives families time and flexibility but can blur work and home life.
entries.because: Parents save travel time, can meet children after school and share chores, yet interruptions, small homes and the pressure to be always available can raise stress.
entries.result: Clear schedules and a separate workspace help.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm việc tại nhà và gia đình.

entries.label_vi: Kiểm soát nhập cư và việc làm: bảo vệ lương và việc làm địa phương trong ngắn hạn; nhưng lao động nhập cư lấp thiếu hụt, tạo việc, đóng thuế
entries.claim: Immigration controls may protect some local jobs but can harm the economy as a whole.
entries.because: Limits can reduce competition for low-skilled work in the short term, yet migrants fill shortages in health, farming and technology, spend money and create businesses that employ locals.
entries.result: Targeted rules work better than strict bans.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhập cư và việc làm.

entries.label_vi: Giờ linh hoạt: tự điều chỉnh, hài lòng, giờ cao điểm; giờ cố định: dễ phối hợp, ranh giới rõ, ổn định
entries.claim: Flexible hours raise satisfaction, while fixed hours help teamwork and routine.
entries.because: Employees who choose when to start can avoid traffic and meet family needs, but a fixed schedule makes meetings easy, sets clear limits and gives life a predictable rhythm.
entries.result: Core hours with flexibility around them combine both.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giờ linh hoạt vs cố định.

entries.label_vi: Tự động hoá công việc: năng suất, chất lượng, an toàn, chi phí; nhưng mất việc, bất bình đẳng, phụ thuộc, vốn đầu tư
entries.claim: Automation raises efficiency and safety but threatens jobs.
entries.because: Machines work faster, make fewer errors and take over dangerous tasks, yet workers in routine roles lose employment, gains go to owners and retraining is slow.
entries.result: Support for displaced workers must accompany automation.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tự động hoá.

entries.label_vi: Tuần làm việc ngắn: sức khoẻ, tập trung, giữ nhân viên, thời gian gia đình; nhưng khó cho dịch vụ liên tục, chi phí, sản lượng giảm
entries.claim: A shorter workweek improves wellbeing and often keeps output steady.
entries.because: Employees with an extra day off are rested and focused and are less likely to quit, but hospitals, shops and factories need cover, and some firms may struggle with deadlines or costs.
entries.result: It works best in knowledge jobs and with careful scheduling.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tuần làm việc ngắn.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ và thất nghiệp: phá việc cũ, tạo nghề mới (lập trình, bảo trì, thương mại điện tử); giảm thất nghiệp nhờ nền tảng việc làm, đào tạo trực tuyến, doanh nghiệp mới
entries.claim: Technology destroys some jobs but can reduce unemployment through new industries and better matching.
entries.because: Job websites connect workers with employers, online courses teach skills cheaply and new technologies create businesses and roles that did not exist before.
entries.result: The effect depends on training and policy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ giảm thất nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Thương mại quốc tế và việc làm: tạo việc ở ngành xuất khẩu, hàng rẻ; nhưng mất việc ở ngành bị cạnh tranh, chuyển nhà máy, cần hỗ trợ chuyển đổi
entries.claim: International trade creates jobs in some sectors and destroys them in others.
entries.because: Export industries hire more people and imports cut prices, yet factories that cannot compete close, leaving local workers unemployed unless they receive retraining and support.
entries.result: Gains are real but unevenly shared.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thương mại và việc làm.

entries.label_vi: Hỗ trợ khởi nghiệp: vốn (quỹ, khoản vay), giảm thuế, giảm thủ tục, ươm tạo, cố vấn, liên kết đại học
entries.claim: Governments can help start-ups with finance, simpler rules and advice.
entries.because: New firms struggle to get loans and to cope with paperwork, so grants, tax relief, one-stop registration and incubators with mentors give them time to grow.
entries.result: Successful start-ups create jobs and innovation.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề hỗ trợ khởi nghiệp.

entries.label_vi: Công đoàn: thương lượng lương, an toàn, chống sa thải bất công; nhưng đình công gây gián đoạn, cản trở linh hoạt, bảo vệ không đều
entries.claim: Employees should be allowed to unionise because collective bargaining protects fair pay and safety.
entries.because: Individuals have little power against large employers, while unions negotiate wages, conditions and protection from unfair dismissal, although strikes can disrupt services and rigid rules may slow change.
entries.result: Rights should come with responsible use.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công đoàn.

entries.label_vi: Công nghệ giảm việc lao động chân tay: máy móc thay công việc lặp lại; nhưng tạo việc kỹ thuật, bảo trì, nghề tay nghề không thay được (thợ ống nước, xây)
entries.claim: Technology reduces many manual jobs but not all of them.
entries.because: Machines replace repetitive factory and farm work, yet skilled trades such as plumbing, building and care need adaptable hands, and new jobs appear in programming and maintenance.
entries.result: Manual work changes in nature rather than vanishing.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công nghệ và lao động chân tay.

entries.label_vi: Nghỉ hưu sớm: thời gian cho sức khoẻ, gia đình, sở thích; làm lâu hơn: thu nhập, mục đích, trí tuệ, giảm gánh quỹ hưu trí
entries.claim: Early retirement offers time and health while working longer gives income and purpose.
entries.because: People who stop early can enjoy hobbies and family and avoid wear and tear, yet those who work longer earn more, keep active minds and reduce pressure on pension systems.
entries.result: Choice and flexible retirement suit most people.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nghỉ hưu sớm vs muộn.

entries.label_vi: Thực tập có lương: kinh nghiệm, kết nối, kỹ năng; nhưng lương thấp, công việc thay nhân viên, bất bình đẳng; cần quy định
entries.claim: Paid internships are not exploitation when they teach real skills and are fairly regulated.
entries.because: Interns gain experience and contacts that help their careers, but some firms use them as cheap labour with little training, so rules on pay, hours and tasks are needed.
entries.result: Good internships benefit both sides.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thực tập.

entries.label_vi: Làm từ xa với nhà tuyển dụng: tiết kiệm văn phòng, tuyển rộng, giữ nhân viên; nhưng khó giám sát, văn hoá, bảo mật
entries.claim: Telecommuting saves employers money but makes management and security harder.
entries.because: Firms need less office space and can hire from anywhere, yet supervising staff, building culture and protecting data become harder.
entries.result: Clear goals and secure systems are essential.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm từ xa góc nhìn nhà tuyển dụng.

entries.label_vi: Thất nghiệp thanh niên: nguyên nhân thiếu kinh nghiệm, kỹ năng không khớp, suy thoái, nghề không ổn định; giải pháp học nghề, thực tập, trợ cấp tuyển dụng, liên kết trường – doanh nghiệp
entries.claim: Youth unemployment results from inexperience and mismatched skills, and it can be reduced through training and links with employers.
entries.because: Employers prefer experienced applicants, courses do not always teach needed skills and recessions hit new entrants first, so apprenticeships, wage subsidies and cooperation between schools and firms help.
entries.result: Young people gain a first step into work.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thất nghiệp thanh niên.

entries.label_vi: Văn phòng mở: dễ giao tiếp, tiết kiệm; nhưng ồn, xao nhãng, thiếu riêng tư, giảm tập trung
entries.claim: Open-plan offices harm concentration even if they encourage conversation.
entries.because: Noise and interruptions make deep work hard and reduce privacy, so employees often spend time wearing headphones or leave the desk to find quiet.
entries.result: Mixed layouts with quiet rooms work better.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề văn phòng mở.

entries.label_vi: Giảm ngày lễ để tăng năng suất: ngày lễ nghỉ ngơi, gia đình, văn hoá, du lịch; nhiều giờ không đồng nghĩa năng suất; kiệt sức
entries.claim: Reducing public holidays would not raise productivity and would harm wellbeing.
entries.because: Holidays let workers recover, spend time with family and support tourism and culture, while extra working days bring tired staff and little additional output.
entries.result: Rest is part of a productive economy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm ngày lễ.

entries.label_vi: Làm từ xa giảm tắc đường: ít người đi làm, giảm khí thải; nhưng đi lại khác tăng, hiệu ứng bật lại, chỉ vài ngày
entries.claim: Remote work reduces peak-hour congestion but does not remove it.
entries.because: Fewer people commute at rush hour and emissions fall, yet some workers make other trips, many jobs cannot be done at home and freed road space attracts other drivers.
entries.result: It helps most as part of wider transport policy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm từ xa và tắc đường.

entries.label_vi: Tăng tuổi hưu: giảm áp lực quỹ hưu, giữ kinh nghiệm, người sống thọ; nhưng công việc nặng, bất bình đẳng sức khoẻ, ít việc cho người trẻ
entries.claim: Higher retirement ages ease pension costs but impose social costs on some workers.
entries.because: People live longer so working later keeps pension funds solvent and experience in the workforce, yet manual workers and those in poor health struggle, and young jobseekers may find fewer openings.
entries.result: Flexibility and exemptions are needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tăng tuổi nghỉ hưu.

entries.label_vi: Đổi nghề: kinh tế thay đổi nhanh, nghề biến mất; kỹ năng chuyển đổi, học suốt đời; nhưng chi phí, rủi ro
entries.claim: Career switching has become a necessary skill in changing economies.
entries.because: Technology and globalisation make some jobs disappear and create others, so workers who can retrain and move between fields stay employable, although changing is costly and risky.
entries.result: Support for adult education makes switching easier.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đổi nghề.

entries.label_vi: Làm từ xa tăng năng suất và hài lòng; hại công ty và làm việc nhóm: khó sáng tạo, văn hoá yếu, người mới; hybrid
entries.claim: Remote work raises satisfaction for employees but may weaken company culture and teamwork.
entries.because: Staff concentrate better and value flexibility, yet chance conversations, mentoring and creative collaboration decline when people rarely meet.
entries.result: Hybrid models combine both.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề làm từ xa: năng suất vs làm việc nhóm.

entries.label_vi: Nhà ở và vấn đề xã hội: nhà tồi, quá đông, vô gia cư gây tội phạm, sức khoẻ, học tập; nhưng nguyên nhân còn do thu nhập, giáo dục, việc làm
entries.claim: Poor housing contributes to social problems but is not their only cause.
entries.because: Overcrowded, unsafe or unaffordable homes damage health, schooling and family stability, yet low income, unemployment and weak education also drive crime and poverty.
entries.result: Housing is one major factor among several.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhà ở và vấn đề xã hội.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông công cộng cải thiện đời sống: đi lại rẻ, tiếp cận việc và học, giảm tắc đường, ô nhiễm, tai nạn; nhưng chậm, đông, vùng xa thiếu
entries.claim: Public transport improves lives by giving affordable access to work, education and services.
entries.because: People without cars can reach jobs and hospitals cheaply, cities have less congestion and pollution, and passengers can read or rest, although service can be crowded or missing in remote areas.
entries.result: Investment widens opportunity and cuts pollution.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông công cộng.

entries.label_vi: Luật điều tiết nhà ở công: tiêu chuẩn chất lượng, phân bổ công bằng, giá thuê, chống tham nhũng; nhưng cứng nhắc, tốn kém, giảm đầu tư
entries.claim: Public housing should be regulated by law to ensure quality and fair allocation.
entries.because: Clear rules on standards, rents and eligibility protect tenants and prevent favouritism, although excessive regulation can raise costs and discourage building.
entries.result: Balanced legislation keeps public housing effective.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề luật nhà ở công.

entries.label_vi: Đô thị hoá: người trẻ có việc làm, giáo dục, giải trí nhưng nhà đắt, áp lực; người già cô đơn, thiếu dịch vụ phù hợp, ô nhiễm, nhưng có y tế
entries.claim: Urbanisation brings opportunity to the young but isolation and strain to many older people.
entries.because: Young adults find jobs, universities and social life in cities, yet face high rents, while older residents may lose community ties, struggle with crowds and traffic, and benefit mainly from hospitals.
entries.result: Cities need housing and services for every age.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề đô thị hoá và các thế hệ.

entries.label_vi: Xe điện: không khí sạch, ít ồn, chi phí vận hành thấp, giảm nhiên liệu hoá thạch; nhưng giá cao, thiếu trạm sạc, pin sản xuất ô nhiễm, điện bẩn
entries.claim: Electric cars cut local pollution and running costs but face high prices and charging limits.
entries.because: They emit nothing from the exhaust, are quiet and cheap to run, yet purchase prices, scarce chargers, battery production and electricity from coal reduce their benefit.
entries.result: The net gain grows as grids become cleaner.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề xe điện.

entries.label_vi: Giảm tắc đường: phí tắc nghẽn, giao thông công cộng, làn xe đạp, giờ làm so le, chia sẻ xe, giá đỗ xe
entries.claim: Governments can cut congestion by charging for road use and improving alternatives.
entries.because: Fees at peak times discourage unnecessary trips, while reliable buses and trains, safe cycle lanes and flexible working hours give people other options.
entries.result: Combined measures keep traffic moving.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giảm tắc đường.

entries.label_vi: Bằng lái khó hơn: giảm tai nạn, lái xe có trách nhiệm, huấn luyện thực hành lâu hơn; nhưng cản trở việc làm, tốn kém, bất công
entries.claim: A harder driving test would make roads safer if it focuses on real skills.
entries.because: Longer practice, hazard training and stricter tests reduce reckless young drivers, although higher costs and difficulty can exclude people who need cars for work.
entries.result: Quality of training matters more than difficulty alone.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề bằng lái xe.

entries.label_vi: Chi cho giao thông công cộng hay đường: GTCC giảm tắc, ô nhiễm, công bằng; đường cần cho xe tải, vùng xa, xe cấp cứu; cân bằng theo vùng
entries.claim: Public transport serves more people per unit of space, but roads remain essential for goods and remote areas.
entries.because: Trains and buses carry many passengers with less pollution and help those without cars, whereas freight, rural communities and emergency services depend on good roads.
entries.result: Spending should depend on local needs.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chi tiêu GTCC vs đường.

entries.label_vi: Thành phố: việc làm, giáo dục, giải trí, dịch vụ; ồn, đắt, ô nhiễm; nông thôn: yên tĩnh, rẻ, cộng đồng, không khí; ít cơ hội, dịch vụ
entries.claim: City life offers opportunity and variety, while the countryside offers peace and community.
entries.because: Cities have jobs, universities and entertainment but are expensive, noisy and polluted, whereas rural areas are quiet, affordable and close-knit but lack services and employment.
entries.result: Choice depends on stage of life and priorities.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thành phố vs nông thôn.

entries.label_vi: Vô gia cư: nguyên nhân giá nhà cao, mất việc, bệnh tâm thần, nghiện, gia đình đổ vỡ; giải pháp nhà giá rẻ, hỗ trợ sức khoẻ, việc làm, can thiệp sớm
entries.claim: Homelessness results from high housing costs and personal crises, so solutions need housing and support.
entries.because: Rent increases, job loss, illness, addiction and family breakdown can leave people without shelter, so affordable homes, mental health care and job training help them to recover.
entries.result: Housing first, plus support, reduces long-term homelessness.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề vô gia cư.

entries.label_vi: Căn hộ: gần tiện ích, rẻ hơn, an ninh, bảo trì chung; nhà riêng: không gian, vườn, riêng tư, đầu tư; xa trung tâm, đắt, bảo trì
entries.claim: Apartments offer convenience and affordability, while houses offer space and privacy.
entries.because: Flats are usually closer to work, shops and transport and are cheaper and easier to maintain, whereas houses give gardens, quiet and room for families but cost more and often lie far from the centre.
entries.result: The choice depends on budget and family stage.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề căn hộ vs nhà riêng.

entries.label_vi: Tai nạn giao thông: nguyên nhân tốc độ, rượu, mệt mỏi, điện thoại, đường xấu, xe kém; giải pháp luật, camera, giáo dục, cải thiện đường, kiểm định xe
entries.claim: Most accidents come from human behaviour and poor roads, so both enforcement and engineering are needed.
entries.because: Speeding, drink driving, tiredness and phone use cause crashes, and bad road design and old vehicles increase risk, so cameras, penalties, education and better roads reduce harm.
entries.result: Deaths fall where rules are enforced and roads are safe.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề tai nạn giao thông.

entries.label_vi: Xe điện scooter: nguy hiểm vì tốc độ, vỉa hè, không mũ bảo hiểm, người đi bộ; nhưng tiện, ít ô nhiễm; cần luật làn, giới hạn tốc độ, mũ
entries.claim: Electric scooters are dangerous when used without rules, though they offer clean short-distance travel.
entries.because: Riders travel fast on pavements and often without helmets, causing injuries to themselves and pedestrians, yet scooters reduce car use if speed limits, lanes and parking rules apply.
entries.result: Regulation can make them safer.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề xe scooter điện.

entries.label_vi: Xe không người lái: an toàn hơn, tiện, người già; nhưng công nghệ, pháp lý, chi phí, mất việc, tin cậy; phổ biến ở khu vực nhất định
entries.claim: Driverless cars will become common in some places but not everywhere within twenty years.
entries.because: They can reduce human error and help non-drivers, yet complex traffic, legal questions, high costs and public trust slow adoption, and professional drivers may lose jobs.
entries.result: Robotaxis and highways come first.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề xe tự lái.

entries.label_vi: Lợi ích tập trung nhà ở công: giảm vô gia cư, ổn định xã hội, giá thuê hợp lý, cộng đồng hỗn hợp; ví dụ Singapore, Vienna
entries.claim: A country that focuses on public housing gains stability, lower housing stress and mixed communities.
entries.because: Affordable state homes protect families from rent shocks, reduce homelessness and let workers live near jobs, while well-planned estates keep different income groups together.
entries.result: Social cohesion and economic security improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề lợi ích nhà ở công / giá phải chăng.

entries.label_vi: An toàn xe đạp: làn riêng bảo vệ, giới hạn tốc độ, đèn tín hiệu cho xe đạp, giáo dục tài xế, mũ bảo hiểm, đèn
entries.claim: Protected lanes and lower speeds are the most effective way to keep cyclists safe.
entries.because: Physical separation from traffic prevents collisions, while lower limits, priority at junctions and driver training reduce risk, and lights and helmets protect cyclists themselves.
entries.result: Safer roads encourage more people to cycle.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề an toàn xe đạp.

entries.label_vi: Trung tâm cộng đồng: gặp gỡ, lớp học, thể thao, hỗ trợ người già, trẻ em, người nhập cư; chống cô lập; cần kinh phí
entries.claim: Community centres bring neighbours together and provide services that cities otherwise lack.
entries.because: They offer classes, sport, childcare and advice to people of all ages, reduce loneliness and help newcomers to integrate, although they need steady funding and good management.
entries.result: Stronger communities and lower social isolation.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề trung tâm cộng đồng.

entries.claim: High-density cities use land and energy efficiently but can feel crowded and expensive.

entries.claim: Rural depopulation results from a lack of jobs and services, so investment in both is needed to keep people.
entries.because: Young people leave for work and study, farms become less profitable and schools and clinics close, but fast internet, local business support and decent transport can make villages viable.
entries.result: Villages that offer livelihoods retain residents.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề dân cư nông thôn giảm.

entries.label_vi: Sở hữu nhà: an toàn, tài sản, ổn định, tự do sửa; nhưng nợ thế chấp lớn, kém linh hoạt, chi phí bảo trì, rủi ro giá
entries.claim: Owning a home gives security and an asset, but it brings debt and reduces mobility.
entries.because: Owners avoid rent rises and build wealth as mortgages are repaid, yet large loans, repair bills and the difficulty of moving for work are heavy burdens.
entries.result: Ownership suits those with stable jobs and savings.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sở hữu nhà.

entries.label_vi: Ô nhiễm giao thông: xe cũ chạy xăng dầu, tắc đường, thiếu GTCC, khí thải diesel; giải pháp vùng khí thải thấp, xe điện, GTCC, phí, kiểm định
entries.claim: Traffic pollution comes from old, congested and diesel vehicles, so cities must cut car use and clean the fleet.
entries.because: Idling in queues and ageing engines release particles and nitrogen oxides, so low-emission zones, electric buses, charges and better public transport reduce them.
entries.result: Air quality and health improve.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề ô nhiễm giao thông.

entries.label_vi: Sở hữu tư nhân gây vấn đề xã hội: bất bình đẳng, tham lam; nhưng khuyến khích đổi mới, trách nhiệm, tự do; vấn đề còn do giáo dục, thiếu cơ hội
entries.claim: Private ownership can widen inequality but is not the main cause of social problems.
entries.because: Concentrated ownership leaves some without property or influence, yet it also rewards effort and innovation, and problems such as crime or poverty arise mostly from poor education and a lack of opportunity.
entries.result: Fair rules and redistribution address the harms.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sở hữu tư nhân.

entries.label_vi: Cải thiện GTCC giảm bất bình đẳng: kết nối khu nghèo với việc làm, trường, y tế; giá vé hợp lý; giảm chi phí xe; mở rộng cơ hội
entries.claim: Better public transport reduces inequality by connecting poorer areas with jobs and services.
entries.because: People without cars are tied to the jobs, schools and clinics within walking distance, so cheap, reliable routes widen their choices and save the cost of owning a vehicle.
entries.result: Opportunity becomes more equal.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề GTCC và bất bình đẳng.

entries.label_vi: Khu dân cư khép kín: an ninh, riêng tư, tiện ích chung, giá trị tài sản; nhưng chia rẽ xã hội, loại trừ, mất tương tác, giao thông; khu mở: hoà nhập, tiếp cận
entries.claim: Gated communities offer security and amenities, while open neighbourhoods encourage integration.
entries.because: Walls and guards give residents a feeling of safety and shared facilities, yet they separate social groups, limit public access and weaken contact between neighbours, whereas open areas keep streets lively.
entries.result: Choice depends on valuing safety or community.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề khu dân cư khép kín.

entries.label_vi: Quy hoạch phân vùng chặt: tách công nghiệp khỏi nhà ở, bảo vệ không gian xanh, kiểm soát chiều cao; nhưng đẩy giá nhà, hạn chế xây, kém linh hoạt
entries.claim: Strict zoning protects residential quality but can raise housing costs.
entries.because: Separating factories from homes, protecting parks and limiting building height make neighbourhoods pleasant, yet tight limits restrict new homes and push prices up.
entries.result: Flexible, well-designed zoning works best.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề quy hoạch phân vùng.

entries.label_vi: Cải tạo đô thị: nhà mới, an ninh, kinh tế, hạ tầng; nhưng di dời cư dân, tăng giá thuê, mất cộng đồng; bồi thường, quyền trở lại
entries.claim: Urban renewal improves neighbourhoods but may displace the people who lived there.
entries.because: New buildings, services and investment raise safety and property values, yet rising rents and evictions push out low-income residents and destroy community ties.
entries.result: Compensation and the right to return are essential.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề cải tạo đô thị.

entries.label_vi: Thành phố thông minh: giao thông thông minh, tiết kiệm năng lượng, dịch vụ trực tuyến, an toàn; nhưng chi phí, quyền riêng tư, bất bình đẳng số
entries.claim: Smart cities will improve efficiency and convenience, but privacy and cost limit the gain.
entries.because: Sensors manage traffic, lighting and waste and online services save time, yet constant data collection and high costs worry citizens and may leave poorer districts behind.
entries.result: Quality of life improves where technology serves residents.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề thành phố thông minh.

entries.label_vi: Học lái xe giúp độc lập: tự đi làm, học, du lịch; đặc biệt nông thôn; nhưng chi phí, tắc, ô nhiễm; GTCC cũng cho độc lập
entries.claim: Learning to drive increases independence, especially where public transport is poor.
entries.because: A driver can reach work, shops and family without timetables, which matters in villages, yet cars are costly, and good public transport can also give freedom.
entries.result: The value depends on where one lives.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề học lái xe và độc lập.

entries.label_vi: Sở hữu nhà là dấu hiệu thành công: tài sản, ổn định, địa vị; nhưng thành công còn là hạnh phúc, sức khoẻ, quan hệ; thuê vẫn hợp lý; giá nhà khiến nhiều người không mua nổi
entries.claim: Home ownership can reflect success, but it is not the only or best measure of a good life.
entries.because: A home shows savings and stability, yet many successful people rent by choice, and high prices stop talented young workers from buying, so happiness and relationships matter more.
entries.result: Definitions of success should be broader.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề sở hữu nhà là thành công.

entries.label_vi: Công viên mở 24 giờ: tập thể dục sớm, người đi làm ca, du lịch, giảm đông; nhưng an toàn ban đêm, phá hoại, ồn, chi phí giám sát, động vật
entries.claim: Open-all-night parks give flexibility but raise safety and cost concerns.
entries.because: Shift workers, joggers and visitors could use green space at any hour, yet darkness invites vandalism, noise and crime and needs extra lighting and patrols.
entries.result: Limited night opening in safe areas is a compromise.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề công viên mở 24 giờ.

entries.label_vi: Đi xe đạp đi làm: rẻ, khoẻ, sạch, nhanh ở nội đô; nhưng thời tiết, an toàn, quãng đường xa, đồ mang; xe: nhanh, thoải mái, quãng xa, nhưng đắt, tắc, ô nhiễm
entries.claim: Cycling to work is cheap, healthy and clean, while motor vehicles offer speed and comfort over longer distances.
entries.because: Cyclists keep fit and avoid traffic jams in compact cities, yet weather, danger and distance limit them, whereas cars and motorbikes are comfortable but costly and polluting.
entries.result: The best mode depends on distance and infrastructure.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề xe đạp vs xe có động cơ đi làm.

entries.label_vi: Giá thuê nhà cao: nhu cầu đô thị cao, thiếu nguồn cung, đầu cơ, thu nhập tăng chậm, lãi suất; giải pháp xây nhà mới, nhà xã hội, kiểm soát giá thuê, thuế nhà trống, hỗ trợ thuê
entries.claim: High rents result from too little housing supply and strong demand, so governments should build more and protect tenants.
entries.because: Cities attract workers faster than homes are built, investors buy property to hold, and wages lag behind prices, so new construction, social housing, tax on empty homes and rent support help.
entries.result: More supply and fair rules stabilise rents.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giá thuê cao.

entries.label_vi: Nhà ở là việc riêng hay công: lựa chọn cá nhân, thị trường; nhưng nhà ở cơ bản, vô gia cư, ảnh hưởng xã hội; nhà nước điều tiết, hỗ trợ
entries.claim: Housing is a private choice in the market but also a public concern because everyone needs shelter.
entries.because: Individuals choose where and how to live, yet shortages, homelessness and poor conditions affect health, education and public budgets, so governments must set standards and help those in need.
entries.result: Both private choice and public duty are needed.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề nhà ở: riêng hay công.

entries.label_vi: Giao thông công cộng ưu/nhược: rẻ, giảm tắc, ô nhiễm, an toàn; nhưng giờ cố định, đông, chậm, khó cho hàng nặng, mất riêng tư
entries.claim: Public transport is cheap and clean but less flexible than a car.
entries.because: Shared vehicles cut costs, congestion and emissions, yet fixed routes, crowding, delays and limited late services make them inconvenient.
entries.result: Frequent, safe services overcome most drawbacks.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề giao thông công cộng ưu nhược.

entries.label_vi: Khả năng chi trả nhà ở là trách nhiệm chính phủ: thị trường thất bại; nhà ở thiết yếu; bình đẳng; công cụ: xây nhà xã hội, trợ cấp thuê, quy hoạch, thuế; trách nhiệm chung với tư nhân
entries.claim: Governments should take responsibility for housing affordability because markets alone leave many people priced out.
entries.because: Shelter is a basic need, and land shortages and speculation drive prices beyond ordinary incomes, so public housing, rent support, planning reform and tax measures are needed alongside private builders.
entries.result: Stable housing supports health, education and the economy.
entries.reuse_vi: Đề chính phủ chịu trách nhiệm nhà ở.
